Dua aur Qubuliyat. Is surat ke shuru mein jo paanch huroof hain unhein huroof-e-muqatta'ah kaha jata hai, inka tafsili bayan hum Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein kar chuke hain. Allah ke bande Hazrat Zakariya Nabi (Alaihis Salam) par jo lutf-e-Ilahi nazil hua uska waqiya bayan ho raha hai. Ek qira'at hai, yeh lafz madd se bhi hai aur qasr se bhi. Dono qira'atein mashhoor hain. Aap Bani Israel ke zabardast Rasool the. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai aap barh-e-ee (carpenter) ka pesha kar ke apna pet paltay thay. Rabb se dua karte hain lekin is wajah se ke logon ke nazdeek yeh anokhi dua thi koi sunta to khayal karta ke lo burhapay mein aulad ki chahat hui hai. Aur yeh wajah bhi thi ke poshida dua Allah ko zyada pyari hoti hai aur qubuliyat se zyada qareeb hoti hai. Allah Ta'ala muttaqi dil ko ba-khubi janta hai aur ahistagi ki aawaz ko poori tarah sunta hai. Ba'z salaf ka qaul hai ke jo shakhs apne walon ki poori neend ke waqt uthe aur poshidagi se Allah ko pukare ke "Aie mere parwardigar! Aie mere palanhaar! Aie mere Rabb!", Allah Ta'ala usi waqt jawab deta hai ke "Labbaik! Main maujood hoon, main tere paas hoon." Dua mein kehte hain ke "Aie Allah mere qavi kamzor ho gaye hain, meri haddiyan khokhli ho chuki hain, mere sar ke balon ki siyahi ab to safedee se badal gayi hai" yaani zahiri aur poshidagi ki tamam taaqatein zayil ho chuki hain, andaruni aur beruni zo'f ne gher liya hai. "Main tere darwaze se kabhi khali haath nahi gaya, tujh Kareem se jo manga tu ne ata farmaya." Mawali ko Kisai ne mawali parha hai. Murad is se asbah hain. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) se khafat ko khafat parhna marwi hai, yaani mere baad mere waris bahut kam hain. Pehli qira'at par matlab yeh hai ke chunke meri aulad nahi aur jo mere rishteydar hain unse khauf hai ke mabada yeh kaheen mere baad koi bura tasarruf na kar dein, to tu mujhe aulad inayat farma jo mere baad meri nabuwat sanbhalay. Yeh hargiz na samjha jaye ke aap ko apne maal-o-amlak ke idhar udhar ho jaane ka khauf tha. Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) is se bahut paak hain. Unka martaba is se bahut sawa hai ke woh is liye aulad mangen ke agar aulad na hui to mera wirsah door ke rishteydaron mein chala jayega. Doosre ba-zahir yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) jo umar bhar apni haddiyan peel kar barh-e-ee ka kaam kar ke apna pet apne haath ke kaam se paltay rahe, unke paas aisi kaun si bari raqam thi ke jis ke wirshe ke liye is qadar pas-o-pesh hota ke kaheen yeh daulat haath se nikal na jaye. Anbiya Alaihimas Salam to yoon bhi sari duniya se zyada maal se be-raghbat aur duniya ke zahid hotay hain. Teesri wajah yeh bhi hai ke Bukhari-o-Muslim mein kayi sanadton se hadith hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke hamara wirsah taqseem nahi hota, jo kuch hum chhorrein sab sadaqah hai. Tirmidhi mein sahih sanad se

isi liye Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke woh mera aur Aal-e-Yaqub ka waris ho. Jaise farman hai ke (Wawasir Sulaimana Dawuda) Sulaimana Dawuda (Alaihis Salam) ke waris hue. Yaani nabuwat ke waris hue. Na ke maal ke warna maal mein aur aulaad bhi shareek hoti hai. Takhsees nahi hoti. Chauthi wajah yeh bhi hai aur yeh bhi maqool wajah hai ke aulaad ka waris hona to aam hai, sab mein hai tamaam mazhabon mein hai phir koi zaroorat na thi ke Hazrat Zakariya apni dua mein yeh wajah bayaan farmate is se saaf sabit hai ke woh wirasat koi khalis wirasat thi aur woh nabuwat ka waris banna tha. Pas in tamaam wujoh se sabit hai ke is se murad wirasat-e-nabuwat hai. Jaise ke hadith mein hai hum jama'at-e-anbiya ka wirasat nahi batta hum jo chhod jayen sadaqa hai. Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain murad wirasat-e-ilm hai. Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) aulaad-e-Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) mein the. Abu Salih (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke murad yeh hai ke woh bhi apne bado ki tarah Nabi hai. Hasan (Rahimahullah) farmate hain nabuwat aur ilm ka waris bane. Sudi (Rahimahullah) ka qaul hai meri aur Aal-e-Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ki nabuwat ka woh waris ho. Zaid bin Aslam bhi yahi farmate hain Abu Salih ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke mere maal ka aur khandan-e-Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ki nabuwat ka woh waris ho. Abdur Razzaq mein hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) par raham kare bhala unhe wirasat-e-maal se kya gharz thi? Allah Ta'ala Lut (Alaihis Salam) par raham kare woh kisi mazboot qile ki tamanna karne lage. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya mere bhai Zakariya par Allah ka raham ho kehne lage اے Allah mujhe apne paas se wali ata farma jo mera aur Aal-e-Yaqub ka waris bane lekin yeh sab hadeeshein mursal hain jo sahih ahadees ka mu'arza nahi kar sakteen Wallahu A'lam. Aur اے Allah use apna pasandeedah ghulaam bana le aur aisa deen-dar diyanatdaar bana ke teri mohabbat ke alawa tamaam makhlooq bhi is se mohabbat kare is ka deen aur akhlaq har ek pasandeedgi aur pyar ki nazar se dekhe.

Dua aur Qubuliyat. Is surat ke shuru mein jo paanch huroof hain unhein huroof-e-muqatta'ah kaha jata hai, inka tafsili bayan hum Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein kar chuke hain. Allah ke bande Hazrat Zakariya Nabi (Alaihis Salam) par jo lutf-e-Ilahi nazil hua uska waqiya bayan ho raha hai. Ek qira'at hai, yeh lafz madd se bhi hai aur qasr se bhi. Dono qira'atein mashhoor hain. Aap Bani Israel ke zabardast Rasool the. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai aap barh-e-ee (carpenter) ka pesha kar ke apna pet paltay thay. Rabb se dua karte hain lekin is wajah se ke logon ke nazdeek yeh anokhi dua thi koi sunta to khayal karta ke lo burhapay mein aulad ki chahat hui hai. Aur yeh wajah bhi thi ke poshida dua Allah ko zyada pyari hoti hai aur qubuliyat se zyada qareeb hoti hai. Allah Ta'ala muttaqi dil ko ba-khubi janta hai aur ahistagi ki aawaz ko poori tarah sunta hai. Ba'z salaf ka qaul hai ke jo shakhs apne walon ki poori neend ke waqt uthe aur poshidagi se Allah ko pukare ke "Aie mere parwardigar! Aie mere palanhaar! Aie mere Rabb!", Allah Ta'ala usi waqt jawab deta hai ke "Labbaik! Main maujood hoon, main tere paas hoon." Dua mein kehte hain ke "Aie Allah mere qavi kamzor ho gaye hain, meri haddiyan khokhli ho chuki hain, mere sar ke balon ki siyahi ab to safedee se badal gayi hai" yaani zahiri aur poshidagi ki tamam taaqatein zayil ho chuki hain, andaruni aur beruni zo'f ne gher liya hai. "Main tere darwaze se kabhi khali haath nahi gaya, tujh Kareem se jo manga tu ne ata farmaya." Mawali ko Kisai ne mawali parha hai. Murad is se asbah hain. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) se khafat ko khafat parhna marwi hai, yaani mere baad mere waris bahut kam hain. Pehli qira'at par matlab yeh hai ke chunke meri aulad nahi aur jo mere rishteydar hain unse khauf hai ke mabada yeh kaheen mere baad koi bura tasarruf na kar dein, to tu mujhe aulad inayat farma jo mere baad meri nabuwat sanbhalay. Yeh hargiz na samjha jaye ke aap ko apne maal-o-amlak ke idhar udhar ho jaane ka khauf tha. Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) is se bahut paak hain. Unka martaba is se bahut sawa hai ke woh is liye aulad mangen ke agar aulad na hui to mera wirsah door ke rishteydaron mein chala jayega. Doosre ba-zahir yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) jo umar bhar apni haddiyan peel kar barh-e-ee ka kaam kar ke apna pet apne haath ke kaam se paltay rahe, unke paas aisi kaun si bari raqam thi ke jis ke wirshe ke liye is qadar pas-o-pesh hota ke kaheen yeh daulat haath se nikal na jaye. Anbiya Alaihimas Salam to yoon bhi sari duniya se zyada maal se be-raghbat aur duniya ke zahid hotay hain. Teesri wajah yeh bhi hai ke Bukhari-o-Muslim mein kayi sanadton se hadith hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke hamara wirsah taqseem nahi hota, jo kuch hum chhorrein sab sadaqah hai. Tirmidhi mein sahih sanad se

isi liye Aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke woh mera aur Aal-e-Yaqub ka waris ho. Jaise farman hai ke (Wawasir Sulaimana Dawuda) Sulaimana Dawuda (Alaihis Salam) ke waris hue. Yaani nabuwat ke waris hue. Na ke maal ke warna maal mein aur aulaad bhi shareek hoti hai. Takhsees nahi hoti. Chauthi wajah yeh bhi hai aur yeh bhi maqool wajah hai ke aulaad ka waris hona to aam hai, sab mein hai tamaam mazhabon mein hai phir koi zaroorat na thi ke Hazrat Zakariya apni dua mein yeh wajah bayaan farmate is se saaf sabit hai ke woh wirasat koi khalis wirasat thi aur woh nabuwat ka waris banna tha. Pas in tamaam wujoh se sabit hai ke is se murad wirasat-e-nabuwat hai. Jaise ke hadith mein hai hum jama'at-e-anbiya ka wirasat nahi batta hum jo chhod jayen sadaqa hai. Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain murad wirasat-e-ilm hai. Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) aulaad-e-Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) mein the. Abu Salih (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke murad yeh hai ke woh bhi apne bado ki tarah Nabi hai. Hasan (Rahimahullah) farmate hain nabuwat aur ilm ka waris bane. Sudi (Rahimahullah) ka qaul hai meri aur Aal-e-Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ki nabuwat ka woh waris ho. Zaid bin Aslam bhi yahi farmate hain Abu Salih ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke mere maal ka aur khandan-e-Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ki nabuwat ka woh waris ho. Abdur Razzaq mein hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) par raham kare bhala unhe wirasat-e-maal se kya gharz thi? Allah Ta'ala Lut (Alaihis Salam) par raham kare woh kisi mazboot qile ki tamanna karne lage. Dua qabool hui. Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ki dua maqbool hoti hai aur farmaya jata hai ke aap ek bachche ki khushkhabri sun lein jis ka naam Yahya hai jaise aur ayat mein hai (Hunalika da'a Zakariyya Rabbahu) [3 Aal-e-Imran: 38], mein Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ne apne Rab se dua ki ke "Aye Allah mujhe apne paas se behtareen aulad ata farma tu duaoon ka sunne wala hai." Farishton ne unhein awaz di aur woh us waqt ki namaz ki jagah mein khade the ke "Allah Ta'ala aap ko apne ek kalme ki basharat deta hai jo sardar hoga aur pakbaz hoga aur Nabi hoga aur poore naik-kar aala darje ke bhale logon mein se hoga." Yahan farmaya ke un se pehle is naam ka koi aur insan nahi hua. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se mushabeh koi aur na hoga, yahi maana sami-a ka ayat (Hal ta'lamu lahu samiyyan) [19 Maryam: 65] mein hai. Yeh maana bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke is se pehle kisi banjh aurat se aisi aulad nahi hui. Hazrat Zakariya ke haan koi aulad nahi hoti thi. Aap ki biwi sahiba bhi shuroo umr se be-aulad thin. Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) aur Hazrat Sarah (Alaihimas Salam) ne bhi bachche ke hone ki basharat sun kar behad taajjub kiya tha lekin un ke taajjub ki wajah un ka be-aulad hona aur banjh hona na thi, balki bahut zyada budhape mein aulad ka hona yeh taajjub ki wajah thi aur Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ke haan toh is poore budhape tak koi aulad hui na thi is liye Hazrat Khalilullah (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya tha ke "Mujhe is intehai budhape mein tum aulad ki khabar kaise de rahe ho?" Warna is se terah saal pehle aap ke haan Hazrat Ismail (Alaihis Salam) hue the. Aap ki biwi sahiba ne bhi khushkhabri ko sun kar taajjub se kaha tha ke "Kya is badhe hue budhape mein mere haan aulad hogi? Sath hi mere miyan bhi ghayat darje ke budhe hain. Yeh toh sakht tar taajjub-khaiz cheez hai." Yeh sun kar farishton ne kaha ke "Kya tumhe Amr-e-Ilahi se taajjub hai? Aye Ibrahim ke gharane walo! Tum par Allah ki rehmatein aur us ki barkatein hain, Allah tareefon aur buzurgiyon wala hai."

Basharat-e-Qubuliyat sun kar. Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) apni dua ki qubuliyat aur apne han larka hone ki basharat sun kar khushi aur tajjub se kaifiyat daryaft karne lage ke zahir asbab to yeh amr musta'ad aur namumkin maloom hota hai. Donon janib se halat na-umidi ki hai. Biwi banjh jis se ab tak aulad nahi hui mein burha aur behad burha jis ki haddiyon mein ab to goda bhi nahi raha khushk tahni jaisa ho gaya hoon ghar wali bhi burhiya phoos ho gayi hai phir hamare han aulad kaise hogi? Gharz Rabb-ul-Alamin se kaifiyat buwajah tajjub-o-khushi daryaft ki. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu) se riwayat hai ke main tamam sunnaton ko janta hoon lekin mujhe yeh maloom nahi hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Zuhar Asr mein parhte the ya nahi? Aur na yeh maloom hai ke is lafz ko 'atiyan parhte the ya 'asiyan (Ahmad). Farishte ne jawab diya ke yeh to wada ho chuka usi halat mein usi biwi se tumhare han larka hoga Allah ke zimme yeh kaam mushkil nahi. Is se zyada tajjub wala aur is se bari qudrat wala kaam to tum khud dekh chuke ho aur woh khud tumhara wajood hai jo kuch na tha aur Allah Ta'ala ne bana diya. Pas jo tumhari paidaish par qadir tha woh tumhare han aulad dene par bhi qadir hai. Jise farman hai: (Hal ata 'alal-insani hinum minad-dairi lam yakun shai'am mazkura) (Al-Insan: 1). Yani yaqinan insan par us ke zamane ka aisa waqt bhi guzra hai jis mein woh koi qabil-e-zikr cheez hi na tha.

Tashaffi-e-qalb ke liye ek aur maang. Hazrat Zakariya Alaihis Salam apne mazeed itminan aur tashaffi-e-qalb ke liye Allah se dua karte hain ke is baat par koi nishan zahir farma jaise ke Khalilullah Alaihis Salam ne murdon ke ji uthne ke dekhne ki tamanna isi liye zahir farmai thi to irshad hua ke tu gonga na hoga bimar na hoga lekin teri zuban logon se baatein na kar sakegi teen din raat tak yehi halat rahegi. Yehi hua bhi ke tasbeeh, istighfar, hamd-o-sana waghera par to zuban chalti thi lekin logon se baat nahi kar sakte the. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu se ye bhi marwi hai ke sowya ke maani pai dar pai ke hain yaani musalsal barabar teen shab-o-roz tumhari zuban duniyawi baaton se ruki rahegi. Pehla qaul bhi aap hi se marwi hai aur jamhoor ki tafsir bhi yehi hai aur yehi zyada sahih hai chunache Surah Al-Imran mein is ka bayan bhi guzar chuka hai ke alamat talab karne par farman hua ke teen din tak tum sirf isharon kinayon se logon se baatein kar sakte ho. Haan apne Rabb ki yaad bakasrat karo aur subh-o-sham is ki pakeezgi bayan karo. Pas in teen din raat mein aap kisi insan se koi baat nahi kar sakte the haan isharon se apna matlab samjha diya karte the lekin ye nahi ke aap gonge ho gaye hon. Ab aap apne hujre se jahan jakar tanhai mein apne han aulad hone ki dua ki thi bahar aaye aur jo nemat Allah ne aap par inaam ki thi aur jis tasbeeh-o-zikar ka aap ko hukum hua tha wahi qaum ko bhi hukum diya lekin chunke bol na sakte the is liye unhein isharon se samjhaya ya zameen par likh kar unhein samjha diya.

Paidaish Yahya Alaihis Salam. Bimutabiq bisharat-e-Ilahi Hazrat Zakariya A.S ke han Hazrat Yahya A.S paida huwe. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein Taurat sikha di jo un mein padhi jaati thi aur jis ka ahkam naik log aur anbiya doosron ko batlate thay us waqt un ki umar bachpan ki hi thi isisi liye apni is anokhi nemat ka bhi zikr kiya ke bacha bhi diya aur usay asmani kitab ka aalim bhi bachpan se hi kardiya aur hukm de diya ke hirs ijtihad koshish aur quwat ke sath Kitabullah seekh le. Sath hi hum ne usay isi kam umri mein fehm-o-ilm, quwat-o-azm, danai aur hilm ata farmaya naikiyon ki taraf bachpan se hi jhuk gaye aur koshish-o-khuloos ke sath Allah ki ibadat aur makhlooq ki khidmat mein lag gaye. Bachche aap se khelne ko kehte thay magar yeh jawab paate thay ke hum khel ke liye paida nahi kiye gaye. Hazrat Yahya A.S ka wajood Hazrat Zakariya A.S ke liye hamari rahmat ka karishma tha jis par bajuz hamare aur koi qadir nahi. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se yeh bhi marwi hai ke wallah main nahi jaanta ke Hannan ka matlab kya hai lughat mein muhabbat shafqat rahmat waghera ke mani mein yeh aata hai ba-zahir yeh matlab maloom hota hai ke hum ne usay bachpan se hi hukm diya aur usay shafqat-o-muhabbat aur pakeezgi ata farmai. Musnad Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs jahannam mein ek hazar saal tak Ya Hannan ya Mannan pukarta rahega pas har mail kachail se har gunah aur masiyat se aap bachay huwe thay. Sirf naik aamal aap ki umar ka khulasa tha aap gunahon se aur Allah ki nafarmaniyon se yaksu thay sath hi maan baap ke farmanbardar itaat guzar aur un ke sath naik salook thay kabhi kisi baat mein maan baap ki mukhalifat nahi ki kabhi un ke farman se bahar nahi hote kabhi kisi ki rok ke baad kisi kaam ko nahi kiya koi sarkashi koi nafarmani ki kho aap mein na thi. In awsaf-e-jameela aur khsail-e-hameeda ke badle teenon halaton mein aap ko Allah ki taraf se amn-o-aman aur salamati mili. Yaani paidaish wale din maut wale din aur hashr wale din. Yehi teenon jaghein ghabrahat ki aur anjaan hoti hain. Insan maan ke pait se nikalte hi ek nayi duniya dekhta hai jo us ki aaj tak ki duniya se azeem-us-shaan aur bilkul mukhtalif hoti hai maut wale din us makhlooq se wabasta padta hai jis se hayat mein kabhi bhi wasta nahi pada unhein kabhi na dekha. Mahshar wale din bhi ala-hazal-qiyas apne tain ek bahut bade majma mein jo bilkul nayi cheez hai dekh kar hairat zada ho jata hai. Pas in teenon waqton mein Allah ki taraf se Hazrat Yahya A.S ko salamati mili. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tamam log qayamat ke din kuch na kuch gunah lekar jayenge siwaye Hazrat Yahya A.S ke. Hazrat Qatada kehte hain ke aap ne gunah bhi kabhi nahi kiya. Yeh hadith marfoo'an aur do sanadon se bhi marwi hai lekin woh dono sanadein bhi zaeef hain wallahu a'lam.

Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ne jawab diya: Aap mujhse behtar hain, Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne farmaya: Main ne aap hi apne upar salam kiya aur aap par khud Allah ne salam kaha. Ab un donon ne hi Allah ki fazilat zahir ki.

Naamumkin ko mumkin banane pe qadir Allah Ta'ala. Upar Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ka zikr hua tha aur yeh bayan farmaya gaya tha ki woh apne poore budhape tak be-aulad rahe, unki biwi ko kuch hua hi na tha balki aulad ki salahiyat hi na thi, us par Allah ne is umr mein unke haan apni qudrat se aulad ata farmai. Hazrat Yahya (Alaihis Salam) paida hue jo naik-kaar aur wafa-shaar the. Uske baad isse bhi barh kar apni qudrat ka nazara pesh karta hai. Hazrat Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ka waqia bayan karta hai ki woh kanwari theen. Kisi mard ka haath tak unhe na laga tha aur be-mard ke Allah Ta'ala ne mahz apni qudrat-e-kaamila se unhe aulad ata farmai. Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) jaisa farzand unhe diya jo Allah ke barguzida paighambar aur Roohullah aur Kalimatullah the. Pas chunke in do qisson mein poori munasibat hai, isliye yahan bhi aur Surah Al-Imran mein bhi aur Surah Anbiya mein bhi in dono ko mutassil bayan farmaya. Taaki bande Allah Ta'ala ki be-misaal qudrat aur azeem-ush-shan saltanat ka mu'aina kar lein. 

Hazrat Maryam (Alaihis Salam) Imran ki sahibzadi theen, Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ki nasl mein se theen. Bani Israel mein yeh gharana tayyib-o-tahir tha. Surah Al-Imran mein aap ki paidaish waghera ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Us zamane ke dastoor ke mutabiq aap ki walida sahibah ne aap ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki Masjid-e-Aqdas ki khidmat ke liye duniyawi kaamon se aazad kar diya tha. Allah ne yeh nazr qubool farma li aur Hazrat Maryam ki nashv-o-numa behtareen taur par ki aur aap Allah ki ibadat mein, riyazat mein aur nekiyon mein mashghool ho gayeen. Aap ki ibadat-o-riyazat, zuhd-o-taqwa zabaan-zad-e-awaam ho gaya. Aap apne khalu Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ki parwarish-o-tarbiyat mein theen, jo us waqt ke Bani Israeli nabi the. Tamam Bani Israel deeni umoor mein unhi ke tabe-farman the. Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) par Hazrat Maryam (Razi Allahu Anha) ki bahut si karamatein zahir huin, khusoosan yeh ki jab kabhi aap unke ibadat-khane mein jaate, nayi qism ke be-mausam phal wahan maujood paate. Daryaft kiya karte ki "Maryam! Yeh kahan se aaye?" Jawab milta ki "Allah Ta'ala ke paas se." Woh aisa qadir hai ki jise chahe be-hisaab roziyan ata farmaye. 

Ab Allah Ta'ala ka irada hua ki Hazrat Maryam ke batn se Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ko paida kare, jo munjumlah paanch Ulul-Azm paighambaron ke ek hain. Aap Masjid-e-Quds ke mashriqi janib gayeen, ya toh bujh-e-kapre aane ke ya kisi aur sabab se. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain ki Ahl-e-Kitab par Baitullah Sharif ki taraf mutawajjah hona aur hajj karna farz kiya gaya tha, lekin chunke Maryam Siddiqa (Razi Allahu Anha) Bait-ul-Muqaddas se mashriq ki taraf gayeen theen, jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai, is wajah se un logon ne mashriq rukh namazein shuru kar dien. Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki wiladat-gah ko unhon ne az-khud qibla bana liya. 

Marwi hai ki jis jagah aap gayeen thin, woh jagah yahan se door aur be-abaad thi. Kehte hain ki wahan aap ka khet tha, jise pani pilane ke liye aap gayeen theen. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki wohin hujra bana liya tha ki logon se alag-thalag ibadat-e-Ilahi mein faraghat ke sath mashghool rahein. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Isa A.S ki pedaish. Jab yeh logon se door gayin aur un mein aur aap mein hijab hogaya. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke paas apne ameen farishte Hazrat Jibrail A.S ko bheja, woh poori insani shakal mein aap par zahir hue. Yahan rooh se murad yehi buzurg farishte hain. Jaise aayat-e-Quran (Nazala bihi ar-roohul ameen) 26. Ash-Shu'ara: 193 mein hai. Ubayy bin Ka'b kehte hain ke roz-e-azal mein jab ke Ibn-e-Adam ki tamam roohon se Allah ka ikraar liya gaya tha. Isi rooh ne aap se baatein keen aur aap ke jism mein hulool kar gayi. Lekin yeh qool alawa ghareeb hone ke bilkul hi munkar hai, bohat mumkin hai ke yeh Bani Israeele qool ho. Aap ne jab is tanhai ke makan mein ek ghair shakhs ko dekha toh yeh samajh kar ke kahin yeh koi bura aadmi na ho, ise Allah ka khauf dilaya ke agar tu parhezgar hai toh Allah ka khauf kar. Main Allah ki panah chahti hoon. Itna pata toh aap ko un ke bashre se chal gaya tha ke yeh koi bhala insan hai aur yeh janti thin ke naik shakhs ko Allah ka dar aur khauf kafi hai. Farishte ne aap ka khauf-o-haras, dar aur ghabrahat door karne ke liye saaf keh diya ke aur koi guman na karo main toh Allah ka bheja hua farishta hoon. Kehte hain ke Allah ka naam sun kar Hazrat Jibrail A.S kaanp uthe aur apni soorat par aagaye aur keh diya main Allah ka qasid hoon. Is liye Allah ne mujhe bheja hai ki woh tujhe ek paak nafs farzand ata karna chahta hai. Li-ahaba ki doosri qiraat Liyahaba hai. Abu Amr bin Alaa jo ek mashhoor maroof qari hain, un ki yehi qiraat hai. Dono qiraaton ki taujeeh aur matlab bilkul saaf hai aur dono mein istilzam bhi hai. Yeh sun kar Maryam Siddiqa A.S ko aur tajjub hua ke SubhanAllah mujhe bacha kaise hoga? Mera toh nikah hi nahi hua aur burai ka mujhe tasawwur tak nahi hua. Mere jism par kisi insan ka kabhi haath hi nahi laga. Main badkar nahi phir mere haan aulaad kaisi! "Baghya" se murad zina-kar hai jaise hadees mein bhi yeh lafz isi maani mein hai ke mahr-ul-baghi zaniya ki kharchi haram hai. Farishte ne aap ke tajjub ko yeh farma kar door karna chaha ki yeh sab sach hai lekin Allah is par qadir hai ke baghair khawand ke aur baghair kisi aur baat ke bhi aulaad de de. Woh jo chahe hojata hai. Allah Ta'ala is bache ko aur is waqie ko apne bandon ki tazkeer ka sabab bana dega. Yeh qudrat-e-Ilahi ki ek nishani hogi taaki log jaan len ke woh Khaliq har tarah ki pedaish par qadir hai. Adam A.S ko baghair aurat mard ke paida kiya, Hawwa ko sirf mard se baghair aurat ke paida kiya. Baaqi tamam انسانon ko mard-o-aurat se paida kiya siwai Hazrat Isa A.S ke ke woh baghair mard ke sirf aurat se hi paida hue. Pas taqseem ki yeh chaar hi sooratein ho sakti thin jo sab poori kardi gayin aur apni kamal qudrat aur azeem saltanat ki misaal qaim kardi. Fi-al-waqie na is ke siva koi mabood na parwardigar. Aur yeh bacha Allah ki rehmat banega, Rab ka paighambar banega, Allah ki ibadat ki dawat is ki makhlooq ko dega.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke farishton ne kaha, "Aye Maryam! Allah Ta'ala tujhe apne ek kalme ki khushkhabri sunata hai jis ka naam Masih Isa bin Maryam hoga jo duniya aur aakhirat mein aabru-dar hoga aur hoga bhi Allah ka muqarrab. Woh gehvapore mein hi bolne lagega aur adheed umr mein bhi, aur saleh logon mein se hoga." Yaani bachpan aur budhape mein Allah ke deen ki dawat dega. 

Marvi hai ke Hazrat Maryam ne farmaya ke khalwat aur tanhai ke moqe par mujh se Hazrat Isa (A.S) bolte thay aur majma mein Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karte thay. Yeh haal us waqt ka hai jab ke aap mere pait mein thay. 

Phir farmata hai ke yeh kaam Ilm-e-Ilahi mein muqaddar aur muqarrar ho chuka hai, woh apni qudrat se yeh kaam poora kar ke hi rahega. 

Bahut mumkin hai ke yeh qaul bhi Hazrat Jibril (A.S) ka ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh farmaan-e-Ilahi Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) se ho aur murad is se rooh ka phoonk dena ho. Jaise farmaan hai ke Imraan ki beti Maryam ba-ismat biwi thin, hum ne us mein rooh phoonki thi. Aur aayat mein hai: "Woh ba-ismat aurat jis mein hum ne apni rooh phoonk di." 

Pas is jumla ka matlab yeh hai ke yeh to ho kar hi rahega, Allah Ta'ala is ka irada kar chuka hai.

Surah Al-Imran mein aap ki paidaish waghera ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Us zamane ke dastoor ke mutabiq aap ki walida sahibah ne aap ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki Masjid-e-Aqdas ki khidmat ke liye duniyawi kaamon se aazad kar diya tha. Allah ne yeh nazr qubool farma li aur Hazrat Maryam ki nashv-o-numa behtareen taur par ki aur aap Allah ki ibadat mein, riyazat mein aur nekiyon mein mashghool ho gayeen. Aap ki ibadat-o-riyazat, zuhd-o-taqwa zabaan-zad-e-awaam ho gaya. Aap apne khalu Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ki parwarish-o-tarbiyat mein theen, jo us waqt ke Bani Israeli nabi the. Tamam Bani Israel deeni umoor mein unhi ke tabe-farman the. Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) par Hazrat Maryam (Razi Allahu Anha) ki bahut si karamatein zahir huin, khusoosan yeh ki jab kabhi aap unke ibadat-khane mein jaate, nayi qism ke be-mausam phal wahan maujood paate. Daryaft kiya karte ki "Maryam! Yeh kahan se aaye?" Jawab milta ki "Allah Ta'ala ke paas se." Woh aisa qadir hai ki jise chahe be-hisaab roziyan ata farmaye. 

Ab Allah Ta'ala ka irada hua ki Hazrat Maryam ke batn se Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ko paida kare, jo munjumlah paanch Ulul-Azm paighambaron ke ek hain. Aap Masjid-e-Quds ke mashriqi janib gayeen, ya toh bujh-e-kapre aane ke ya kisi aur sabab se. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain ki Ahl-e-Kitab par Baitullah Sharif ki taraf mutawajjah hona aur hajj karna farz kiya gaya tha, lekin chunke Maryam Siddiqa (Razi Allahu Anha) Bait-ul-Muqaddas se mashriq ki taraf gayeen theen, jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai, is wajah se un logon ne mashriq rukh namazein shuru kar dien. Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki wiladat-gah ko unhon ne az-khud qibla bana liya. 

Marwi hai ki jis jagah aap gayeen thin, woh jagah yahan se door aur be-abaad thi. Kehte hain ki wahan aap ka khet tha, jise pani pilane ke liye aap gayeen theen. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki wohin hujra bana liya tha ki logon se alag-thalag ibadat-e-Ilahi mein faraghat ke sath mashghool rahein. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Isa A.S ki pedaish. Jab yeh logon se door gayin aur un mein aur aap mein hijab hogaya. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke paas apne ameen farishte Hazrat Jibrail A.S ko bheja, woh poori insani shakal mein aap par zahir hue. Yahan rooh se murad yehi buzurg farishte hain. Jaise aayat-e-Quran (Nazala bihi ar-roohul ameen) 26. Ash-Shu'ara: 193 mein hai. Ubayy bin Ka'b kehte hain ke roz-e-azal mein jab ke Ibn-e-Adam ki tamam roohon se Allah ka ikraar liya gaya tha. Isi rooh ne aap se baatein keen aur aap ke jism mein hulool kar gayi. Lekin yeh qool alawa ghareeb hone ke bilkul hi munkar hai, bohat mumkin hai ke yeh Bani Israeele qool ho. Aap ne jab is tanhai ke makan mein ek ghair shakhs ko dekha toh yeh samajh kar ke kahin yeh koi bura aadmi na ho, ise Allah ka khauf dilaya ke agar tu parhezgar hai toh Allah ka khauf kar. Main Allah ki panah chahti hoon. Itna pata toh aap ko un ke bashre se chal gaya tha ke yeh koi bhala insan hai aur yeh janti thin ke naik shakhs ko Allah ka dar aur khauf kafi hai. Farishte ne aap ka khauf-o-haras, dar aur ghabrahat door karne ke liye saaf keh diya ke aur koi guman na karo main toh Allah ka bheja hua farishta hoon. Kehte hain ke Allah ka naam sun kar Hazrat Jibrail A.S kaanp uthe aur apni soorat par aagaye aur keh diya main Allah ka qasid hoon. Is liye Allah ne mujhe bheja hai ki woh tujhe ek paak nafs farzand ata karna chahta hai. Li-ahaba ki doosri qiraat Liyahaba hai. Abu Amr bin Alaa jo ek mashhoor maroof qari hain, un ki yehi qiraat hai. Dono qiraaton ki taujeeh aur matlab bilkul saaf hai aur dono mein istilzam bhi hai. Yeh sun kar Maryam Siddiqa A.S ko aur tajjub hua ke SubhanAllah mujhe bacha kaise hoga? Mera toh nikah hi nahi hua aur burai ka mujhe tasawwur tak nahi hua. Mere jism par kisi insan ka kabhi haath hi nahi laga. Main badkar nahi phir mere haan aulaad kaisi! "Baghya" se murad zina-kar hai jaise hadees mein bhi yeh lafz isi maani mein hai ke mahr-ul-baghi zaniya ki kharchi haram hai. Farishte ne aap ke tajjub ko yeh farma kar door karna chaha ki yeh sab sach hai lekin Allah is par qadir hai ke baghair khawand ke aur baghair kisi aur baat ke bhi aulaad de de. Woh jo chahe hojata hai. Allah Ta'ala is bache ko aur is waqie ko apne bandon ki tazkeer ka sabab bana dega. Yeh qudrat-e-Ilahi ki ek nishani hogi taaki log jaan len ke woh Khaliq har tarah ki pedaish par qadir hai. Adam A.S ko baghair aurat mard ke paida kiya, Hawwa ko sirf mard se baghair aurat ke paida kiya. Baaqi tamam انسانon ko mard-o-aurat se paida kiya siwai Hazrat Isa A.S ke ke woh baghair mard ke sirf aurat se hi paida hue. Pas taqseem ki yeh chaar hi sooratein ho sakti thin jo sab poori kardi gayin aur apni kamal qudrat aur azeem saltanat ki misaal qaim kardi. Fi-al-waqie na is ke siva koi mabood na parwardigar. Aur yeh bacha Allah ki rehmat banega, Rab ka paighambar banega, Allah ki ibadat ki dawat is ki makhlooq ko dega.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke farishton ne kaha, "Aye Maryam! Allah Ta'ala tujhe apne ek kalme ki khushkhabri sunata hai jis ka naam Masih Isa bin Maryam hoga jo duniya aur aakhirat mein aabru-dar hoga aur hoga bhi Allah ka muqarrab. Woh gehvapore mein hi bolne lagega aur adheed umr mein bhi, aur saleh logon mein se hoga." Yaani bachpan aur budhape mein Allah ke deen ki dawat dega. 

Marvi hai ke Hazrat Maryam ne farmaya ke khalwat aur tanhai ke moqe par mujh se Hazrat Isa (A.S) bolte thay aur majma mein Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karte thay. Yeh haal us waqt ka hai jab ke aap mere pait mein thay. 

Phir farmata hai ke yeh kaam Ilm-e-Ilahi mein muqaddar aur muqarrar ho chuka hai, woh apni qudrat se yeh kaam poora kar ke hi rahega. 

Bahut mumkin hai ke yeh qaul bhi Hazrat Jibril (A.S) ka ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh farmaan-e-Ilahi Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) se ho aur murad is se rooh ka phoonk dena ho. Jaise farmaan hai ke Imraan ki beti Maryam ba-ismat biwi thin, hum ne us mein rooh phoonki thi. Aur aayat mein hai: "Woh ba-ismat aurat jis mein hum ne apni rooh phoonk di." 

Pas is jumla ka matlab yeh hai ke yeh to ho kar hi rahega, Allah Ta'ala is ka irada kar chuka hai.

Naamumkin ko mumkin banane pe qadir Allah Ta'ala. Upar Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ka zikr hua tha aur yeh bayan farmaya gaya tha ki woh apne poore budhape tak be-aulad rahe, unki biwi ko kuch hua hi na tha balki aulad ki salahiyat hi na thi, us par Allah ne is umr mein unke haan apni qudrat se aulad ata farmai. Hazrat Yahya (Alaihis Salam) paida hue jo naik-kaar aur wafa-shaar the. Uske baad isse bhi barh kar apni qudrat ka nazara pesh karta hai. Hazrat Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ka waqia bayan karta hai ki woh kanwari theen. Kisi mard ka haath tak unhe na laga tha aur be-mard ke Allah Ta'ala ne mahz apni qudrat-e-kaamila se unhe aulad ata farmai. Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) jaisa farzand unhe diya jo Allah ke barguzida paighambar aur Roohullah aur Kalimatullah the. Pas chunke in do qisson mein poori munasibat hai, isliye yahan bhi aur Surah Al-Imran mein bhi aur Surah Anbiya mein bhi in dono ko mutassil bayan farmaya. Taaki bande Allah Ta'ala ki be-misaal qudrat aur azeem-ush-shan saltanat ka mu'aina kar lein.

Woh gehvapore mein hi bolne lagega aur adheed umr mein bhi, aur saleh logon mein se hoga." Yaani bachpan aur budhape mein Allah ke deen ki dawat dega. 

Marvi hai ke Hazrat Maryam ne farmaya ke khalwat aur tanhai ke moqe par mujh se Hazrat Isa (A.S) bolte thay aur majma mein Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karte thay. Yeh haal us waqt ka hai jab ke aap mere pait mein thay. 

Phir farmata hai ke yeh kaam Ilm-e-Ilahi mein muqaddar aur muqarrar ho chuka hai, woh apni qudrat se yeh kaam poora kar ke hi rahega. 

Bahut mumkin hai ke yeh qaul bhi Hazrat Jibril (A.S) ka ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh farmaan-e-Ilahi Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) se ho aur murad is se rooh ka phoonk dena ho. Jaise farmaan hai ke Imraan ki beti Maryam ba-ismat biwi thin, hum ne us mein rooh phoonki thi. Aur aayat mein hai: "Woh ba-ismat aurat jis mein hum ne apni rooh phoonk di." 

Pas is jumla ka matlab yeh hai ke yeh to ho kar hi rahega, Allah Ta'ala is ka irada kar chuka hai.

Naamumkin ko mumkin banane pe qadir Allah Ta'ala. Upar Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ka zikr hua tha aur yeh bayan farmaya gaya tha ki woh apne poore budhape tak be-aulad rahe, unki biwi ko kuch hua hi na tha balki aulad ki salahiyat hi na thi, us par Allah ne is umr mein unke haan apni qudrat se aulad ata farmai. Hazrat Yahya (Alaihis Salam) paida hue jo naik-kaar aur wafa-shaar the. Uske baad isse bhi barh kar apni qudrat ka nazara pesh karta hai. Hazrat Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ka waqia bayan karta hai ki woh kanwari theen. Kisi mard ka haath tak unhe na laga tha aur be-mard ke Allah Ta'ala ne mahz apni qudrat-e-kaamila se unhe aulad ata farmai. Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) jaisa farzand unhe diya jo Allah ke barguzida paighambar aur Roohullah aur Kalimatullah the. Pas chunke in do qisson mein poori munasibat hai, isliye yahan bhi aur Surah Al-Imran mein bhi aur Surah Anbiya mein bhi in dono ko mutassil bayan farmaya. Taaki bande Allah Ta'ala ki be-misaal qudrat aur azeem-ush-shan saltanat ka mu'aina kar lein. 

Hazrat Maryam (Alaihis Salam) Imran ki sahibzadi theen, Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ki nasl mein se theen. Bani Israel mein yeh gharana tayyib-o-tahir tha. Surah Al-Imran mein aap ki paidaish waghera ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Us zamane ke dastoor ke mutabiq aap ki walida sahibah ne aap ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki Masjid-e-Aqdas ki khidmat ke liye duniyawi kaamon se aazad kar diya tha. Allah ne yeh nazr qubool farma li aur Hazrat Maryam ki nashv-o-numa behtareen taur par ki aur aap Allah ki ibadat mein, riyazat mein aur nekiyon mein mashghool ho gayeen. Aap ki ibadat-o-riyazat, zuhd-o-taqwa zabaan-zad-e-awaam ho gaya. Aap apne khalu Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) ki parwarish-o-tarbiyat mein theen, jo us waqt ke Bani Israeli nabi the. Tamam Bani Israel deeni umoor mein unhi ke tabe-farman the. Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam) par Hazrat Maryam (Razi Allahu Anha) ki bahut si karamatein zahir huin, khusoosan yeh ki jab kabhi aap unke ibadat-khane mein jaate, nayi qism ke be-mausam phal wahan maujood paate. Daryaft kiya karte ki "Maryam! Yeh kahan se aaye?" Jawab milta ki "Allah Ta'ala ke paas se." Woh aisa qadir hai ki jise chahe be-hisaab roziyan ata farmaye. 

Ab Allah Ta'ala ka irada hua ki Hazrat Maryam ke batn se Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ko paida kare, jo munjumlah paanch Ulul-Azm paighambaron ke ek hain. Aap Masjid-e-Quds ke mashriqi janib gayeen, ya toh bujh-e-kapre aane ke ya kisi aur sabab se. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain ki Ahl-e-Kitab par Baitullah Sharif ki taraf mutawajjah hona aur hajj karna farz kiya gaya tha, lekin chunke Maryam Siddiqa (Razi Allahu Anha) Bait-ul-Muqaddas se mashriq ki taraf gayeen theen, jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai, is wajah se un logon ne mashriq rukh namazein shuru kar dien. Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki wiladat-gah ko unhon ne az-khud qibla bana liya. 

Marwi hai ki jis jagah aap gayeen thin, woh jagah yahan se door aur be-abaad thi. Kehte hain ki wahan aap ka khet tha, jise pani pilane ke liye aap gayeen theen. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki wohin hujra bana liya tha ki logon se alag-thalag ibadat-e-Ilahi mein faraghat ke sath mashghool rahein. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Isa A.S ki pedaish. Jab yeh logon se door gayin aur un mein aur aap mein hijab hogaya. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke paas apne ameen farishte Hazrat Jibrail A.S ko bheja, woh poori insani shakal mein aap par zahir hue. Yahan rooh se murad yehi buzurg farishte hain. Jaise aayat-e-Quran (Nazala bihi ar-roohul ameen) 26. Ash-Shu'ara: 193 mein hai. Ubayy bin Ka'b kehte hain ke roz-e-azal mein jab ke Ibn-e-Adam ki tamam roohon se Allah ka ikraar liya gaya tha. Isi rooh ne aap se baatein keen aur aap ke jism mein hulool kar gayi. Lekin yeh qool alawa ghareeb hone ke bilkul hi munkar hai, bohat mumkin hai ke yeh Bani Israeele qool ho. Aap ne jab is tanhai ke makan mein ek ghair shakhs ko dekha toh yeh samajh kar ke kahin yeh koi bura aadmi na ho, ise Allah ka khauf dilaya ke agar tu parhezgar hai toh Allah ka khauf kar. Main Allah ki panah chahti hoon. Itna pata toh aap ko un ke bashre se chal gaya tha ke yeh koi bhala insan hai aur yeh janti thin ke naik shakhs ko Allah ka dar aur khauf kafi hai. Farishte ne aap ka khauf-o-haras, dar aur ghabrahat door karne ke liye saaf keh diya ke aur koi guman na karo main toh Allah ka bheja hua farishta hoon. Kehte hain ke Allah ka naam sun kar Hazrat Jibrail A.S kaanp uthe aur apni soorat par aagaye aur keh diya main Allah ka qasid hoon. Is liye Allah ne mujhe bheja hai ki woh tujhe ek paak nafs farzand ata karna chahta hai. Li-ahaba ki doosri qiraat Liyahaba hai. Abu Amr bin Alaa jo ek mashhoor maroof qari hain, un ki yehi qiraat hai. Dono qiraaton ki taujeeh aur matlab bilkul saaf hai aur dono mein istilzam bhi hai. Yeh sun kar Maryam Siddiqa A.S ko aur tajjub hua ke SubhanAllah mujhe bacha kaise hoga? Mera toh nikah hi nahi hua aur burai ka mujhe tasawwur tak nahi hua. Mere jism par kisi insan ka kabhi haath hi nahi laga. Main badkar nahi phir mere haan aulaad kaisi! "Baghya" se murad zina-kar hai jaise hadees mein bhi yeh lafz isi maani mein hai ke mahr-ul-baghi zaniya ki kharchi haram hai. Farishte ne aap ke tajjub ko yeh farma kar door karna chaha ki yeh sab sach hai lekin Allah is par qadir hai ke baghair khawand ke aur baghair kisi aur baat ke bhi aulaad de de. Woh jo chahe hojata hai. Allah Ta'ala is bache ko aur is waqie ko apne bandon ki tazkeer ka sabab bana dega. Yeh qudrat-e-Ilahi ki ek nishani hogi taaki log jaan len ke woh Khaliq har tarah ki pedaish par qadir hai. Adam A.S ko baghair aurat mard ke paida kiya, Hawwa ko sirf mard se baghair aurat ke paida kiya. Baaqi tamam انسانon ko mard-o-aurat se paida kiya siwai Hazrat Isa A.S ke ke woh baghair mard ke sirf aurat se hi paida hue. Pas taqseem ki yeh chaar hi sooratein ho sakti thin jo sab poori kardi gayin aur apni kamal qudrat aur azeem saltanat ki misaal qaim kardi. Fi-al-waqie na is ke siva koi mabood na parwardigar. Aur yeh bacha Allah ki rehmat banega, Rab ka paighambar banega, Allah ki ibadat ki dawat is ki makhlooq ko dega.

Mariam (Alaiha Salam) aur Hazrat Jibrail (A.S). Marvi hai ke jab Aap Farman-e-Ilahi tasleem kar chukin aur us ke aage gardan jhuka di toh Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne un ke kurte ke garebaan mein phoonk maari. Jis se unhe buhukm-e-Rabb hamal thehar gaya, ab toh sakht ghabraayein aur yeh khayal kaleja masoosne laga ke main logon ko kya munh dikhaungi? Laakh apni baraat pesh karun lekin is anokhi baat ko kaun manega? Isi ghabraahat mein Aap thin, kisi se yeh waqia bayaan nahi kiya tha, haan jab Aap apni khala Hazrat Zakariya ki biwi ke paas gayin toh woh Aap se mo'aniqa karke kehne lagin, bachi! Allah ki qudratt se aur tumhare khalu ki dua se main is umr mein haamla ho gayi hun. Aap ne farmaya, khala jaan! Mere sath yeh waqia guzra hai aur main bhi apne aap ko isi halat mein paati hun. Chunke yeh gharana Nabi ka gharana tha, woh Qudrat-e-Ilahi par aur sadaqat-e-Mariam par iman layin. Ab yeh halat thi ke jab kabhi yeh dono paak aurtein mulaqat kartin toh khala Sahiba yeh mehsoos farmatin ke goya un ka bacha bhanji ke bacha ke samne jhukta hai aur us ki izrat karta hai. Un ke mazhab mein yeh jaiz bhi tha, isi wajah se Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke bhaiyon ne aur aap ke walid ne aap ko sajda kiya tha aur Allah ne farishton ko Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke samne sajda karne ka hukum diya tha, lekin hamari shariat mein yeh taazeem Allah ke liye makhsoos ho gayi aur kisi doosre ko sajda karna haram ho gaya kyunke yeh taazeem-e-Ilahi ke khilaf hai, us ki jalalat ke shayan-e-shaan nahi. 

Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain: Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur Hazrat Yahya (A.S) khala zaad bhai thay, dono ek hi waqt hamal mein thay. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ki walida aksar Hazrat Mariam se farmatin ke mujhe toh aisa maloom hota hai ke mera bacha tere bache ke samne sajda karta hai. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain is se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki fazilat sabit hoti hai kyunke Allah ne aap ke hathon apne hukum se murdon ko zinda kar diya aur madar zaad andhon aur korhiyon ko bhala changa kar diya. 

Jamhoor ka qaul toh yeh hai ke Aap nau mahine tak hamal mein rahein. Ikramah (R.H) farmate hain aath mah tak, isi liye aath mah ke hamal ka bacha umoman zinda nahi rehta. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain hamal ke sath hi bacha ho gaya. Yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Mumkin hai Aap ne ayat ke zahiri alfaaz se yeh samjha ho kyunke hamal ke alag hone ka aur dard-e-za ka zikr in ayaton mein 'fa' ke sath hai aur 'fa' taqeeq ke liye aati hai. Lekin taqeeq har cheez ki us ke aitbaar se hoti hai jaisi aam insanon ki paidaish ka haal ayat-e-Quran (Wa laqad khalaqnal-insana min sulalatin min teen) (Surah (Al-Muminun: 12) mein hua hai ke hum ne insan ko bajti hui mitti se paida kiya phir isay basoorat-e-nutfah raham mein theharaya phir nutfe ko phutki banaya phir us phutki ko loothra banaya, phir us loothre mein haddiyan paida kin. Yahan bhi do jagah 'fa' hai aur hai bhi taqeeq ke liye. Lekin Hadees se sabit hota hai ke in do halaton mein chaalis din ka fasla hota hai.

Quran-e-Kareem ki ayat mein hai: (Alam tara annallaha anzala minas-sama'i ma'an fatusbihul-ardu mukhaddaratan innallaha latifun khabir - 22. (Al-Hajj: 63) Kya tu ne nahi dekha ke Allah Ta'ala asman se barish barsata hai. Pas zameen sarsabz ho jati hai. Zahir hai ke pani barсне ke baad sabza ugta hai. Halanki "fa" yahan bhi hai pas ta'eeq har cheez ke aitbaar se hoti hai. Seedhi si baat to yeh hai ke misl aadat aurton ke Aap ne haml ka zamana poora guzara masjid mein hi. Masjid ke khadim ek sahib aur thay jin ka naam Yusuf Najar tha. Unhon ne jab Maryam (Alaiha Salam) ka yeh haal dekha to dil mein kuch shak sa paida hua lekin Hazrat Maryam ke zuhd-o-taqwa, ibadat-o-riyazat, khashiyat-e-Ilahi aur haqq-beeni ko khayal karte hue unhon ne yeh burai dil se door karni chahi, lekin joon joon din guzarte gaye haml ka izhar hota gaya ab to khamosh na reh sake ek din ba-adab kehne lage ke Maryam main tum se ek baat poochta hoon naraz na hona bhala baghair beej ke kisi darakht ka hona, baghair dane ke khet ka hona, baghair baap ke bachhe ka hona mumkin bhi hai? Aap un ke matlab ko samajh gayin aur jawab diya ke yeh sab mumkin hai sab se pehle jo darakht Allah Ta'ala ne ugaya woh baghair beej ke tha. Sab se pehle jo kheti Allah ne ugai woh baghair dane ki thi, sab se pehle Allah ne Adam (A.S) ko paida kiya woh be-baap ke thay balke be-maan ke bhi. Un ki to samajh mein aa gaya aur Hazrat Maryam (Alaiha Salam) aur Allah ki qudrat ko na jhutla sake. Ab Hazrat Siddiqa ne jab dekha ke qaum ke log un par tuhmat laga rahe hain to Aap un sab ko chhod-chhaad kar door daraaz chali gayin. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (Rahimahullah) farmate hain jab haml ke halaat zahir ho gaye qaum ne phabtiyan phenkin, awazein kasne aur baatein banani shuru kar din aur Hazrat Yusuf Najar jaise salih shakhs par yeh tuhmat uthai to Aap un sab se kinara-kash ho gayin na koi unhein dekhe na Aap kisi ko dekhein. Jab dard-e-zuh utha to Aap khajoor ke ek darakht ki jad mein aa baithein kehte hain ke yeh khilwat-khana Bait-ul-Maqdis ki mashriqi janib ka hujra tha. Yeh bhi qaul hai ke Sham aur Misr ke darmiyan Aap pahunch chuki thin us waqt bachha hone ka dard shuru hua. Aur qaul hai ke Bait-ul-Maqdis se Aap aath meel chali gayin thin us basti ka naam Bait Lahm tha. Mehraaj ke waqie ke bayaan mein pehle ek hadith guzri hai jis mein hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki paidaish ki jagah bhi Bait Lahm tha. Wallahu A'lam. Mashhoor baat bhi yahi hai aur nasraniyon ka to is par ittefaq hai aur is hadith mein bhi hai agar yeh sahih ho. Us waqt Aap maut ki tamna karne lagin kyunke deen ke fitne ke waqt yeh tamna bhi jaiz hai. Manti thin ke koi unhein sacha na kahega un ke bayaan karda waqie ko har shakhs ghadant samjhega. Duniya Aap ko pareshan kar degi aur ibadat-o-itmi'nan mein khalal padega. Har shakhs burai se yaad karega aur logon par bura asar padega.

To farmane lageen kash ke main is halat se pehle hi utha li jati balke main paida hi na ki jati is qadr sharm-o-haya daman-gir hui ke Aap ne is takleef par maut ko tarjeeh di aur tamanna ki ke kash main khoyi hui aur yaad se utri hui cheez ho jati ke na koi yaad kare, na dhoonde, na zikr kare, ahadees mein maut mangne ki mamanat warid hai. Hum ne un riwayaton ko Ayat (TAWAFFANI MUSLIMA WA ALHIQNANI BIS-SALIHEEN) (Yusuf: 101) ki tafseer mein bayan kar diya hai.))

Mariam (Alaiha Salam) aur Hazrat Jibrail (A.S). Marvi hai ke jab Aap Farman-e-Ilahi tasleem kar chukin aur us ke aage gardan jhuka di toh Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne un ke kurte ke garebaan mein phoonk maari. Jis se unhe buhukm-e-Rabb hamal thehar gaya, ab toh sakht ghabraayein aur yeh khayal kaleja masoosne laga ke main logon ko kya munh dikhaungi? Laakh apni baraat pesh karun lekin is anokhi baat ko kaun manega? Isi ghabraahat mein Aap thin, kisi se yeh waqia bayaan nahi kiya tha, haan jab Aap apni khala Hazrat Zakariya ki biwi ke paas gayin toh woh Aap se mo'aniqa karke kehne lagin, bachi! Allah ki qudratt se aur tumhare khalu ki dua se main is umr mein haamla ho gayi hun. Aap ne farmaya, khala jaan! Mere sath yeh waqia guzra hai aur main bhi apne aap ko isi halat mein paati hun. Chunke yeh gharana Nabi ka gharana tha, woh Qudrat-e-Ilahi par aur sadaqat-e-Mariam par iman layin. Ab yeh halat thi ke jab kabhi yeh dono paak aurtein mulaqat kartin toh khala Sahiba yeh mehsoos farmatin ke goya un ka bacha bhanji ke bacha ke samne jhukta hai aur us ki izrat karta hai. Un ke mazhab mein yeh jaiz bhi tha, isi wajah se Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke bhaiyon ne aur aap ke walid ne aap ko sajda kiya tha aur Allah ne farishton ko Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke samne sajda karne ka hukum diya tha, lekin hamari shariat mein yeh taazeem Allah ke liye makhsoos ho gayi aur kisi doosre ko sajda karna haram ho gaya kyunke yeh taazeem-e-Ilahi ke khilaf hai, us ki jalalat ke shayan-e-shaan nahi. 

Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain: Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur Hazrat Yahya (A.S) khala zaad bhai thay, dono ek hi waqt hamal mein thay. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ki walida aksar Hazrat Mariam se farmatin ke mujhe toh aisa maloom hota hai ke mera bacha tere bache ke samne sajda karta hai. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain is se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki fazilat sabit hoti hai kyunke Allah ne aap ke hathon apne hukum se murdon ko zinda kar diya aur madar zaad andhon aur korhiyon ko bhala changa kar diya. 

Jamhoor ka qaul toh yeh hai ke Aap nau mahine tak hamal mein rahein. Ikramah (R.H) farmate hain aath mah tak, isi liye aath mah ke hamal ka bacha umoman zinda nahi rehta. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain hamal ke sath hi bacha ho gaya. Yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Mumkin hai Aap ne ayat ke zahiri alfaaz se yeh samjha ho kyunke hamal ke alag hone ka aur dard-e-za ka zikr in ayaton mein 'fa' ke sath hai aur 'fa' taqeeq ke liye aati hai. Lekin taqeeq har cheez ki us ke aitbaar se hoti hai jaisi aam insanon ki paidaish ka haal ayat-e-Quran (Wa laqad khalaqnal-insana min sulalatin min teen) (Surah (Al-Muminun: 12) mein hua hai ke hum ne insan ko bajti hui mitti se paida kiya phir isay basoorat-e-nutfah raham mein theharaya phir nutfe ko phutki banaya phir us phutki ko loothra banaya, phir us loothre mein haddiyan paida kin. Yahan bhi do jagah 'fa' hai aur hai bhi taqeeq ke liye. Lekin Hadees se sabit hota hai ke in do halaton mein chaalis din ka fasla hota hai.

(Al-Hajj: 63) Kya tu ne nahi dekha ke Allah Ta'ala asman se barish barsata hai. Pas zameen sarsabz ho jati hai. Zahir hai ke pani barсне ke baad sabza ugta hai. Halanki "fa" yahan bhi hai pas ta'eeq har cheez ke aitbaar se hoti hai. Seedhi si baat to yeh hai ke misl aadat aurton ke Aap ne haml ka zamana poora guzara masjid mein hi. Mariam (Alaihas Salam) aur Mujizat. (Min tahtaha) ki dusri qirat min tahtaha bhi hai yeh khatab karne wale Hazrat Jibrail A.S the. Hazrat Isa A.S ka to pehla kalam wahi tha jo aap ne apni walidah ki barat o pakdamni mein logon ke samne kiya tha. Is wadi ke niche ke kinare se us ghabrahat aur pareshani ke aalam mein Hazrat Jibrail A.S ne yeh tashalli di thi. Yeh qaul bhi kaha gaya hai ki yeh baat Hazrat Isa A.S ne hi kahi thi. Aawaz aayi ki ghamgin na ho tere qadmon tale tere Rab ne saf shafaf shirin pani ka chashma jari kar diya hai yeh pani tum pi lo. Aik qaul yeh hai ki is chashmey se murad khud Hazrat Isa A.S hain. Lekin pehla qaul zyada zahir hai. Chunancha is pani ke zikar ke baad hi khane ka zikar hai ki khajoor ke is darakht ko hlao us mein se tarotaza khajoorain jharrein gi woh khao. Kehte hain yeh darakht sukha para hua tha aur yeh qaul bhi hai ki phal daar tha. Ba-zahir aisa maloom hota hai ki us waqt woh darakht khajooron se khali tha lekin aap ke hlate hi us mein se qudrat-e-ilahi se khajoorain jharne lagin khana pina sab kuch mojood ho gaya aur ijazat bhi de di. Farmaya kha pi aur dil ko masroor rakh. Hazrat Amr bin Maimun ka farman hai ki nifas wali aurton ke liye khajooron se aur khushk khajooron se behtar aur koi cheez nahi. Aik hadith mein hai khajoor ke darakht ka ikram karo yeh usi matti se paida hua hai jis se Adam A.S paida hue thay is ke siwa aur koi darakht nar-mada mil kar nahi phalta. Aurton ko wiladat ke waqt tar khajoorain khilao na milen to khushk hi sahi koi darakht is se barh kar Allah ke paas martabe wala nahi. Isi liye is ke niche Hazrat Marium A.S ko utara yeh hadith bilkul munkar hai tasaqut ki dusri qirat tasaqut aur tasqut bhi hai matlab tamam qiraton ka aik hi hai phir irshad hua ki kisi se baat na karna ishare se samjha dena ki main aaj rozey se hoon samjha dena ki samjha dena ki main aaj rozey se hoon ya to murad yeh hai ki un ke rozey mein kalam mamnoo tha ya yeh ki main ne bolne se hi roza rakha hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ke paas do shakhs aaye. Aik ne to salam kiya, dusre ne na kiya aap ne pucha is ki kya wajah? Logon ne kaha is ne qasam khai hai ki aaj yeh kisi se baat na karega aap ne farmaya isey tor de salam kalam shuru kar yeh to sirf Hazrat Marium (Alaihas Salam) ke liye hi tha kyunke Allah ko aap ki sadaqat o karamat sabit karna manzoor thi is liye isey uzr bana diya tha. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid kehte hain jab Hazrat Isa A.S ne apni walidah se kaha ki aap ghabraen nahi to aap ne kaha main kaise na ghabraon khawand wali main nahi, kisi ki malkiyat ki laundi bandi main nahi mujhe duniya na kahe gi ki yeh bacha kaise hua? Main logon ke samne kya jawab de sakungi? Kaun sa uzr paish kar sakungi? Haaye kash ke main is se pehle hi margayi hoti kash ke main nasyan mansiyan ho gayi hoti.

Is waqt Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ne kaha, "Ammaan! Aap ko kisi se bolne ki zarurat nahi, main aap in sab se nipat loon ga. Aap to unhein sirf yeh samjha dena keh aaj se aap ne chup rehne ki nazr maan li hai."

Taqaddus-e-Maryam aur Awam:

Hazrat Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ne Allah ke is hukum ko bhi tasleem kar liya aur apne bachche ko god mein liye hue logon ke paas aaein. Dekhte hi har ek ungusht-ba-dandan reh gaya aur har munh se nikal gaya ke Maryam tu ne to bara hi bura kaam kiya.

Nauf Bakali kehte hain ke log Hazrat Maryam ki justuju mein nikle the lekin Allah ki shaan kahin unhe khoj hi na mila. Raaste mein ek charwaha mila us se pucha ke aisi aisi aurat ko tu ne kahin is jangal mein dekha hai? Us ne kaha nahin. Lekin main ne raat ko ajeeb baat dekhi hai ke meri yeh tamam gaayein is wadi ki taraf sajde mein gir gayin. Main ne to is se pehle kabhi aisa waqia nahi dekha. Aur main ne apni ankhon se dekha hai ke us taraf ek noor nazar aa raha tha. Woh us ki nishandahi par ja rahe the ke samne se Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki walida bachche ko liye hue aati dikhai di gayin, unhe dekh kar aap wahin apne bachche ko god mein liye hue baith gayin. In sab ne aap ko gher liya aur baatein banane lage.

Un ka yeh kehna ke "Ae Haroon ki behan!" is se murad yeh hai ke aap Hazrat Haroon ki nasl se theen. Ya aap ke gharane mein Haroon naam ka ek saleh shakhs tha aur usi ki si ibadat-o-riyazat Hazrat Maryam Siddiqa ki thi. Is liye unhe Haroon ki behan kaha gaya. Koi kehta hai Haroon naam ka ek badkar shakhs tha is liye logon ne taan ki raah se unhe is ki behan kaha.

In sab aqwal se barh kar ghareeb qaul ek yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Haroon aur Moosa ki wohi sagi behan hain jinhe Hazrat Moosa (Alaihis Salam) ki walida ne jab Hazrat Moosa (Alaihis Salam) ko peti mein daal kar darya mein chhoda tha to un se kaha tha ke tum is tarah is ke peechhe peechhe kinare kinare jao ke kisi ko khayal bhi na guzare.

Yeh qaul to bilkul ghalat hota hai is liye ke Quran se sabit hai ke Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) Bani Israel ke aakhri nabi the, aap ke baad sirf Khatam-ul-Anbiya Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) hi nabi hue hain. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai, aap farmate hain ke: "Isa bin Maryam se sab se zyada qareeb main hoon is liye ke mujh mein aur un ke darmiyaan aur koi nabi nahi guzra."

Mulahiza ho aayat: (Alam tara ilal-mala-i mim bani Isra-e-l mim ba'di Moosa) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 246).

In aayaton mein Hazrat Dawood ka waqia aur aap ka Jalout ko qatl karna bayaan hua hai aur lafz maujood hain ke yeh Moosa ke baad ka waqia hai. Unhe jo ghalati lagi hai us ki wajah Taurat ki yeh ibarat hai jis mein hai ke jab Hazrat Moosa ma' Bani Israel ke darya se paar ho gaye aur Firaun ma' apni qaum ke doob mara us waqt Maryam bint Imran ne jo Moosa aur Haroon ki behan theen, daff par Allah ke shukr ke tarane buland kiye, aap ke saath aur auratein bhi theen. Is ibarat se Qarzi (Rahimahullah) ne samajh liya ke yehi Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki walida hain halanki yeh mahz ghalat hai.

Mumkin hai Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki behan ka naam bhi Maryam ho lekin yeh ke yehi Maryam Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki maan theen is ka koi saboot nahi balkay yeh theek namumkin hai ho sakta hai ke naam dono ka aik ho aik naam par doosray naam rakhay jatay hain. Bani Israel mein to aadat thi ke woh apnay nabiyon waliyon ke naam par apnay naam rakhtay thay. Musnad Ahmad mein Mughirah bin Shu'bah (R.A) se marwi hai ke mujhay Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Najran bheja wahan mujh se ba'az Nasraniyon ne poochha ke tum "Ya Ukhta Haroon" parhtay ho halankay Musa (A.S) to Isa (A.S) se bohat pehlay guzray hain mujh se koi jawab ban na para jab main Madinay wapas aaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh zikr kiya to Aap ne farmaya tum ne unhein usi waqt kyun na jawab de diya ke woh log apnay aglay nabiyon aur naik logon ke naam par apnay aur apni aulaadon ke naam barabar rakha kartay thay. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein yeh bhi hadith hai Imam Tirmizi (Rahimahullah) isay Hasan Sahih Gharib batlatay hain. Aik martaba Hazrat Ka'ab ne kaha tha ke yeh Haroon Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bhai Haroon nahi is par Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aishah (R.A) ne inkar kiya to Aap ne kaha ke agar aap ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kuch suna ho tab to hamein manzoor hai warna tarikh tor par to un ke darmiyan chhe so saal ka fasla hai. Yeh sun kar Umm-ul-Momineen (R.A) khamosh ho gayeen. Is tarikh mein hamein qadray taammul hai. Qatadah (Rahimahullah) farmatay hain Hazrat Maryam (A.S) ka gharana oopar se hi naik saleh aur deendar tha aur yeh deendari barabar goya wirasatan chali aa rahi thi. Ba'az log aisay bhi hotay hain aur ba'az gharanay is ke khilaf bhi hotay hain ke oopar se neechay tak sab bad hi bad. Yeh Haroon baray buzurg aadmi thay is wajah se Bani Israel mein Haroon naam rakhnay ka aam tor par shoq ho gaya tha yahan tak mazkoor hai ke jis din Hazrat Haroon ka janaza nikla hai to aap ke janazay mein usi Haroon naam ke chalis hazar aadmi thay. Al-Gharaz woh log malamat karnay lagay ke tum se yeh burai kaisay sarzad ho gayi tum to naik gharanay ki bachi ho maan baap dono saleh sara gharana pak phir tum ne yeh kya harkat ki? Qoum ki yeh karwi kasili batain sun kar hasb-e-farman aap ne apnay bachay ki taraf ishara kar diya ke is se pooch lo. Un logon ko taao par taao aaya ke dekho kya dhitai ka jawab deti hai goya hamein pagal bana rahi hai. Bhala god ke bachay se hum kya poochain gay aur woh hamein kya bataye ga? Itnay mein bin bulaye aap bol uthay ke logon mein Allah ka aik ghulam hoon. Sab se pehla kalam Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka yehi hai. Allah ki tanzeeh aur ta'azim bayaan ki aur apni ghulami aur bandagi ka elan kiya Allah ki zaat ko aulaad se pak bataya balkay sabit kar diya kyun ke aulaad ghulam nahi hoti phir apni nubuwwat ka izhar kar ke mujhay us ne kitab di aur mujhay apna nabi banaya hai. Is mein apni walida ki baraat bayaan ki balkay daleel bhi de di ke main to Allah ka paighambar hoon Rabb ne mujhay apni kitab bhi inayat farma di hai.

Kahte hain ke jab log aap ki walida-e-majida se baatein bana rahe thay aap us waqt doodh pi rahe thay jise chhor kar baayein karwat se ho kar un ki taraf tawajjo farma kar yeh jawab diya. Kahte hain is qaul ke waqt aap ki ungli uthi hui thi aur haath mundhe tak ooncha tha. Ikramah to farmate hain mujhe apne kisi amal ke elaan ki ijazat hai farmaya bhali baat kahne aur buri baat ke rokne ki is liye ke yahi asal deen hai aur yahi Anbiya-e-Allah ka wirsa hai yahi kaam un ke supurd hota raha. Pas jama'ati masla hai ke Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki is aam barkat se murad bhalai ka hukm aur buri se rokna hai. Jahan baithte uthte aate jaate yeh shughl barabar jari rehta. Kabhi Allah ki baatein pahunchane se na rukte. Farmate hain mujhe hukm mila hai ke zindagi bhar tak namaz-o-zakat ka paband rahoon. Yahi hukm hamare Nabi (Alaihis Salatu Wassalam) ko mila. Irshad hai (W'abud Rabbaka hatta yatiyakal yaqeen) marte dam tak apne Rab ki ibadat mein laga reh. Pas Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ne bhi farmaya ke "Us ne mujh par yeh dono kaam meri zindagi ke aakhri lamhe tak likh diye hain." Is se taqdeer ka suboot aur munkireen-e-taqdeer ki tardeed bhi ho jati hai. Rab ki ita'at ke is hukm ke sath hi mujhe apni walida ki khidmat guzari ka bhi hukm mila hai. Umuman Quran mein yeh dono cheezein ek sath bayan hoti hain jaise ayat (Wa qada Rabbuka alla ta'abudu illa iyyahu wa bil-walidaini ihsana) 17. Al-Isra: 23 aur ayat (Anishkur li wa li-walidaika ilayhal maseer) 31. Luqman: 14 mein. Us ne mujhe gardankash nahi banaya ke main us ki ibadat se ya walida ki ita'at se sarkashi aur takabbur karoon aur badbakht ban jaoon. Kahte hain jabbar-o-shaqqi woh hai jo ghusse mein aa kar khoonrezi kar de. Farmate hain maa baap ka nafarman wahi hota hai jo badbakht aur gardankash ho. Bad-khlaq wahi hota hai jo akadne wala aur munafiq ho. Mazkoor hai ke ek martba aap ke mojzaton ko dekh kar ek aurat tajajjub se kahne lagi mubarak hai woh pait jis mein tu ne parwarish payi aur mubarak hai woh seena jis ne tujhe doodh pilaya. Aap ne jawab diya mubarak hai woh jis ne Kitabullah ki tilawat ki phir tabadari ki. Aur sarkash aur badbakht na bana. Phir farmate hain meri paidaish ke din, maut ke baad dobara ji uthne ke din mein mujh par salamati hai is se bhi aap ki uboodiyat aur manjla-e-makhlooq ke ek makhloog-e-Ilahi hona sabit ho raha hai ke aap misl insanoon ke adam se wajood mein aaye phir maut ka maza bhi chakhenge. Phir Qiyamat ke din dobara uthenge bhi. Lekin haan yeh teeno moqe khoob sakht aur kathan hain aap par aasaan aur sahal honge na koi ghabrahat hogi na pareshani balki amn chain aur sarasar salamati hi salamati. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih)

Yeh Haroon baray buzurg aadmi thay is wajah se Bani Israel mein Haroon naam rakhnay ka aam tor par shoq ho gaya tha yahan tak mazkoor hai ke jis din Hazrat Haroon ka janaza nikla hai to aap ke janazay mein usi Haroon naam ke chalis hazar aadmi thay. Al-Gharaz woh log malamat karnay lagay ke tum se yeh burai kaisay sarzad ho gayi tum to naik gharanay ki bachi ho maan baap dono saleh sara gharana pak phir tum ne yeh kya harkat ki? Qoum ki yeh karwi kasili batain sun kar hasb-e-farman aap ne apnay bachay ki taraf ishara kar diya ke is se pooch lo. Un logon ko taao par taao aaya ke dekho kya dhitai ka jawab deti hai goya hamein pagal bana rahi hai. Bhala god ke bachay se hum kya poochain gay aur woh hamein kya bataye ga? Itnay mein bin bulaye aap bol uthay ke logon mein Allah ka aik ghulam hoon. Sab se pehla kalam Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka yehi hai. Allah ki tanzeeh aur ta'azim bayaan ki aur apni ghulami aur bandagi ka elan kiya Allah ki zaat ko aulaad se pak bataya balkay sabit kar diya kyun ke aulaad ghulam nahi hoti phir apni nubuwwat ka izhar kar ke mujhay us ne kitab di aur mujhay apna nabi banaya hai. Is mein apni walida ki baraat bayaan ki balkay daleel bhi de di ke main to Allah ka paighambar hoon Rabb ne mujhay apni kitab bhi inayat farma di hai.

Kahte hain ke jab log aap ki walida-e-majida se baatein bana rahe thay aap us waqt doodh pi rahe thay jise chhor kar baayein karwat se ho kar un ki taraf tawajjo farma kar yeh jawab diya. Kahte hain is qaul ke waqt aap ki ungli uthi hui thi aur haath mundhe tak ooncha tha. Ikramah to farmate hain mujhe apne kisi amal ke elaan ki ijazat hai farmaya bhali baat kahne aur buri baat ke rokne ki is liye ke yahi asal deen hai aur yahi Anbiya-e-Allah ka wirsa hai yahi kaam un ke supurd hota raha. Pas jama'ati masla hai ke Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki is aam barkat se murad bhalai ka hukm aur buri se rokna hai. Jahan baithte uthte aate jaate yeh shughl barabar jari rehta. Irshad hai (W'abud Rabbaka hatta yatiyakal yaqeen) marte dam tak apne Rab ki ibadat mein laga reh. Pas Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ne bhi farmaya ke "Us ne mujh par yeh dono kaam meri zindagi ke aakhri lamhe tak likh diye hain." Is se taqdeer ka suboot aur munkireen-e-taqdeer ki tardeed bhi ho jati hai. Rab ki ita'at ke is hukm ke sath hi mujhe apni walida ki khidmat guzari ka bhi hukm mila hai. Umuman Quran mein yeh dono cheezein ek sath bayan hoti hain jaise ayat (Wa qada Rabbuka alla ta'abudu illa iyyahu wa bil-walidaini ihsana) 17. Al-Isra: 23 aur ayat (Anishkur li wa li-walidaika ilayhal maseer) 31. Luqman: 14 mein. Us ne mujhe gardankash nahi banaya ke main us ki ibadat se ya walida ki ita'at se sarkashi aur takabbur karoon aur badbakht ban jaoon. Kahte hain jabbar-o-shaqqi woh hai jo ghusse mein aa kar khoonrezi kar de. Farmate hain maa baap ka nafarman wahi hota hai jo badbakht aur gardankash ho. Bad-khlaq wahi hota hai jo akadne wala aur munafiq ho. Mazkoor hai ke ek martba aap ke mojzaton ko dekh kar ek aurat tajajjub se kahne lagi mubarak hai woh pait jis mein tu ne parwarish payi aur mubarak hai woh seena jis ne tujhe doodh pilaya. Aap ne jawab diya mubarak hai woh jis ne Kitabullah ki tilawat ki phir tabadari ki. Aur sarkash aur badbakht na bana. Phir farmate hain meri paidaish ke din, maut ke baad dobara ji uthne ke din mein mujh par salamati hai is se bhi aap ki uboodiyat aur manjla-e-makhlooq ke ek makhloog-e-Ilahi hona sabit ho raha hai ke aap misl insanoon ke adam se wajood mein aaye phir maut ka maza bhi chakhenge. Phir Qiyamat ke din dobara uthenge bhi. Lekin haan yeh teeno moqe khoob sakht aur kathan hain aap par aasaan aur sahal honge na koi ghabrahat hogi na pareshani balki amn chain aur sarasar salamati hi salamati. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih)

Taqaddus-e-Maryam aur Awam:

Hazrat Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ne Allah ke is hukum ko bhi tasleem kar liya aur apne bachche ko god mein liye hue logon ke paas aaein. Dekhte hi har ek ungusht-ba-dandan reh gaya aur har munh se nikal gaya ke Maryam tu ne to bara hi bura kaam kiya.

Nauf Bakali kehte hain ke log Hazrat Maryam ki justuju mein nikle the lekin Allah ki shaan kahin unhe khoj hi na mila. Raaste mein ek charwaha mila us se pucha ke aisi aisi aurat ko tu ne kahin is jangal mein dekha hai? Us ne kaha nahin. Lekin main ne raat ko ajeeb baat dekhi hai ke meri yeh tamam gaayein is wadi ki taraf sajde mein gir gayin. Main ne to is se pehle kabhi aisa waqia nahi dekha. Aur main ne apni ankhon se dekha hai ke us taraf ek noor nazar aa raha tha. Woh us ki nishandahi par ja rahe the ke samne se Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki walida bachche ko liye hue aati dikhai di gayin, unhe dekh kar aap wahin apne bachche ko god mein liye hue baith gayin. In sab ne aap ko gher liya aur baatein banane lage.

Un ka yeh kehna ke "Ae Haroon ki behan!" is se murad yeh hai ke aap Hazrat Haroon ki nasl se theen. Ya aap ke gharane mein Haroon naam ka ek saleh shakhs tha aur usi ki si ibadat-o-riyazat Hazrat Maryam Siddiqa ki thi. Is liye unhe Haroon ki behan kaha gaya. Koi kehta hai Haroon naam ka ek badkar shakhs tha is liye logon ne taan ki raah se unhe is ki behan kaha.

In sab aqwal se barh kar ghareeb qaul ek yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Haroon aur Moosa ki wohi sagi behan hain jinhe Hazrat Moosa (Alaihis Salam) ki walida ne jab Hazrat Moosa (Alaihis Salam) ko peti mein daal kar darya mein chhoda tha to un se kaha tha ke tum is tarah is ke peechhe peechhe kinare kinare jao ke kisi ko khayal bhi na guzare.

Taqaddus-e-Maryam aur Awam:

Hazrat Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ne Allah ke is hukum ko bhi tasleem kar liya aur apne bachche ko god mein liye hue logon ke paas aaein. Dekhte hi har ek ungusht-ba-dandan reh gaya aur har munh se nikal gaya ke Maryam tu ne to bara hi bura kaam kiya.

Nauf Bakali kehte hain ke log Hazrat Maryam ki justuju mein nikle the lekin Allah ki shaan kahin unhe khoj hi na mila. Raaste mein ek charwaha mila us se pucha ke aisi aisi aurat ko tu ne kahin is jangal mein dekha hai? Us ne kaha nahin. Lekin main ne raat ko ajeeb baat dekhi hai ke meri yeh tamam gaayein is wadi ki taraf sajde mein gir gayin. Main ne to is se pehle kabhi aisa waqia nahi dekha. Aur main ne apni ankhon se dekha hai ke us taraf ek noor nazar aa raha tha. Woh us ki nishandahi par ja rahe the ke samne se Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki walida bachche ko liye hue aati dikhai di gayin, unhe dekh kar aap wahin apne bachche ko god mein liye hue baith gayin. In sab ne aap ko gher liya aur baatein banane lage.

Un ka yeh kehna ke "Ae Haroon ki behan!" is se murad yeh hai ke aap Hazrat Haroon ki nasl se theen. Ya aap ke gharane mein Haroon naam ka ek saleh shakhs tha aur usi ki si ibadat-o-riyazat Hazrat Maryam Siddiqa ki thi. Is liye unhe Haroon ki behan kaha gaya. Koi kehta hai Haroon naam ka ek badkar shakhs tha is liye logon ne taan ki raah se unhe is ki behan kaha.

In sab aqwal se barh kar ghareeb qaul ek yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Haroon aur Moosa ki wohi sagi behan hain jinhe Hazrat Moosa (Alaihis Salam) ki walida ne jab Hazrat Moosa (Alaihis Salam) ko peti mein daal kar darya mein chhoda tha to un se kaha tha ke tum is tarah is ke peechhe peechhe kinare kinare jao ke kisi ko khayal bhi na guzare.

Yeh qaul to bilkul ghalat hota hai is liye ke Quran se sabit hai ke Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) Bani Israel ke aakhri nabi the, aap ke baad sirf Khatam-ul-Anbiya Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) hi nabi hue hain. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai, aap farmate hain ke: "Isa bin Maryam se sab se zyada qareeb main hoon is liye ke mujh mein aur un ke darmiyaan aur koi nabi nahi guzra."

Pas agar manna parega ke aap Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) aur Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) se bhi pehle the, kyunke Quran-e-Kareem mein maujood hai ke Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) Hazrat Moosa (Alaihis Salam) ke baad hue hain. Mulahiza ho aayat: (Alam tara ilal-mala-i mim bani Isra-e-l mim ba'di Moosa) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 246).

In aayaton mein Hazrat Dawood ka waqia aur aap ka Jalout ko qatl karna bayaan hua hai aur lafz maujood hain ke yeh Moosa ke baad ka waqia hai. Unhe jo ghalati lagi hai us ki wajah Taurat ki yeh ibarat hai jis mein hai ke jab Hazrat Moosa ma' Bani Israel ke darya se paar ho gaye aur Firaun ma' apni qaum ke doob mara us waqt Maryam bint Imran ne jo Moosa aur Haroon ki behan theen, daff par Allah ke shukr ke tarane buland kiye, aap ke saath aur auratein bhi theen. Is ibarat se Qarzi (Rahimahullah) ne samajh liya ke yehi Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki walida hain halanki yeh mahz ghalat hai.

Mumkin hai Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki behan ka naam bhi Maryam ho lekin yeh ke yehi Maryam Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki maan theen is ka koi saboot nahi balkay yeh theek namumkin hai ho sakta hai ke naam dono ka aik ho aik naam par doosray naam rakhay jatay hain. Bani Israel mein to aadat thi ke woh apnay nabiyon waliyon ke naam par apnay naam rakhtay thay. Musnad Ahmad mein Mughirah bin Shu'bah (R.A) se marwi hai ke mujhay Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Najran bheja wahan mujh se ba'az Nasraniyon ne poochha ke tum "Ya Ukhta Haroon" parhtay ho halankay Musa (A.S) to Isa (A.S) se bohat pehlay guzray hain mujh se koi jawab ban na para jab main Madinay wapas aaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh zikr kiya to Aap ne farmaya tum ne unhein usi waqt kyun na jawab de diya ke woh log apnay aglay nabiyon aur naik logon ke naam par apnay aur apni aulaadon ke naam barabar rakha kartay thay. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein yeh bhi hadith hai Imam Tirmizi (Rahimahullah) isay Hasan Sahih Gharib batlatay hain. Qaul ki dusri qirat qaul bhi hai. Ibn Masood ki qirat mein qaal-ul-haq hai. Qaul ka rafa zyada zahir hai jaise (AL-HAQQU MIR RABBIKA FALA TAKOUNANNA MINAL-MUMTARIN) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 147) mein. Idhar hukam hua idhar cheez tayyar mojood. Hazrat Isa ؑ ne apni qaum se yeh bhi farmaya ke mera aur tum sab ka Rab Allah Ta'ala hi hai tum sab usi ki ibadat karte raho. Seedhi rah jise main Allah ki janib se le kar aaya hoon yahi hai. Is ki tabedari karne wala hidayat par hai aur is ka khilaf karne wala gumrahi par hai yeh farman bhi Aap ka maan ki god se hi tha. Hazrat Isa ؑ ke apne bayan aur hukam ke khilaf baad walon ne lab-kushai ki aur un ke bare mein mukhtalif partyon ki shakal mein yeh log bat gaye. Chunacha Yahood ne kaha ke Hazrat Isa ؑ na'uzubillah walad-uz-zina hain, Allah ki la'anten un par hon ke unhon ne Allah ke ek behtareen Rasool par badtareen tuhmat lagayi. Aur kaha ke un ka yeh kalam waghera sab jadoo ke karishme thay. Isi tarah Nasara behak gaye kehne lage ke yeh to khud Allah hai yeh kalam Allah ka hi hai. Kisi ne kaha yeh Allah ka larka hai kisi ne kaha teen maboodon mein se ek hai haan ek jamalat ne waqia ke mutabiq kaha ke Aap Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain yahi qaul sahi hai. Ahl-e-Islam ka aqeeda Hazrat Isa ؑ ki nisbat yahi hai aur yahi taleem-e-Ilahi hai. Kehte hain ke Bani Israel ka majma jama hua hai aur apne mein se unhon ne chaar hazar aadmi chhante har qaum ne apna apna ek aalam paish kiya. Yeh waqia Hazrat Isa ؑ ke aasman par uth jaane ke baad ka hai. Yeh log aapas mein munazae hue ek to kehne lage yeh khud Allah tha jab tak us ne chaha zameen par raha jise chaha jalaya jise chaha mara phir aasman par chala gaya is giroh ko Yaqoobiyah kehte hain lekin aur teeno ne use jhutlaya aur kaha tu ne jhoot kaha ab do ne teesre se kaha achha tu keh tera kya khayal hai?

Us ne kaha woh Allah ke bete the is jama'at ka naam Nastouriya pada. Do jo reh gaye unhon ne kaha tu ne bhi ghalat kaha hai. Phir un do mein se ek ne kaha tum kaho us ne kaha main to yeh aqeedah rakhta hoon ke woh teen mein se ek hain ek to Allah jo ma'abood hai. Doosre yahi jo ma'abood hain teesre un ki walidah jo ma'abood hain. Yeh Israiliyah giroh hua aur yahi Nasraniyon ke badshah the un par Allah ki la'naten hain. Chouthe ne kaha tum sab jhoote ho Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam Allah ke bande hain aur Rasool the Allah hi ka kalma the aur us ke paas ki bheji hui rooh. Yeh log Musalman kehlaye aur yahi sachche the un mein se jis ke taabe jo the woh usi ke qool par ho gaye aur aapas mein khoob uchhle. Choonke sachche Islam wale har zamane mein tadaad mein kam hote hain un par yeh mal'oon chha gaye unhe daba liya unhe marna peetna aur qatal karna shuru kar diya. Aksar moarrikhin ka bayan hai ke Qustuntin badshah ne teen baar Isaaiyon ko jama kiya aakhri martaba ke ijtima mein un ke do hazaar ek sau sattar ulama jama hue the lekin yeh sab aapas mein Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam ke bare mein mukhtalif aara rakhte the. So kuch kehte to sattar aur hi kuch kehte, pachas kuch aur hi keh rahe the, saatht ka aqeedah kuch aur hi tha har ek ka khayal doosre se takra raha tha. Sab se badi jama'at teen sau aath ki thi. Badshah ne is taraf kasrat dekh kar kasrat ka saath diya. Maslihat-e-mulki isi mein thi ke is kaseer giroh ki tarafdari ki jaye lihaza us ki policy ne ise isi taraf mutawajjo kar diya. Aur us ne baaki ke sab logon ko nikalwa diya aur un ke liye Amanat-e-Kubra ki rasm ijad ki jo darasal sab se zyada badtareen khiyanat hai. Ab masail-e-shari'ah ki kitabein in ulama se likhwayen aur bohat si rasumat-e-mulki aur zarooriyat-e-shahri ko sharai soorat mein daakhil kar liya. Bohat si nayi nayi baatein ijad keen aur asli deen-e-Maseehi ki soorat ko maskh kar ke ek majmooa murattab karaya aur ise logon mein raajh kar diya aur us waqt se deen-e-Maseehi yahi samjha jaane laga. Jab is par un sab ko razamand kar liya toh ab charon taraf kilisa, garje aur ibadat-khane banwane aur wahan in ulama ko bithane aur un ke zariye se is apni noumolood masihiyat ko phailane ki koshish mein lag gaya. Sham mein, Jazeerah mein, Room mein taqreeban barah hazaar aise makanat us ke zamane mein tameer karaye gaye us ki maan Hilana ne jis jagah sooli gadhi hui thi wahan ek qubba banwa diya aur us ki baqaidah parastish shuru ho gayi. Aur sab ne yaqeen kar liya ke Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam sooli par chadh gaye halanki un ka yeh qool ghalat hai Allah ne apne is moazzam bande ko apni jaanib aasmaan par chadha liya hai. Yeh Isaai mazhab kam ikhtilaf ki halki si misaal. Aise log jo Allah par jhoot iftara bandhein us ki aulaadein aur shareek-o-hissah daar sabit karein go woh duniya mein mohlat paalein lekin is azeem-ush-shaan din ko un ki halakat unhe charon taraf se gher legi aur barbaad ho jayenge. Allah Ta'ala nafarmanon ko go jaari azaab na kare lekin bilkul chhodta bhi nahin.

Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala zalim ko dheel deta hai lekin jab us ki pakad nazil hoti hai toh phir koi jaye panah baaki nahi rehti. Yeh farma kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne ayat-e-Quran (Wa kazaalika akhzu Rabbika iza akhazal-qura wa hiya zalimatun inna akhzahu aleemun shadeed) (Hud: 102) tilawat farmayi. Yani tere Rab ki pakad ka tarika aisa hi hai jab woh kisi zulm se alooda basti ko pakadta hai. Yaqeen mano ke us ki pakad nihayat almonak aur sakht hai. Bukhari Muslim ki aur hadith mein hai ke napasand baaton ko sun kar sabr karne wala Allah se zyada koi nahi. Log us ki aulaad batlate hain aur woh unhein roziyan de raha hai aur aafiyat bhi. Khud Quran farmata hai (Wa ka-ayyin min qaryatin amlaitu laha wa hiya zalimatun thumma akhaztuha wa ilaynal-maseer) (Al-Hajj: 48) bohat si bastiyon wale woh hain jin ke zalim hone ke bawajood main ne unhein dheel di phir pakad liya aakhir lotna toh meri hi jaanib hai. Aur ayat mein hai ke zalim log apne aamal se Allah ko ghafil samjhein unhein jo mohlat hai woh us din tak hai jis din aankhein oopar chadh jayengi. Yahi farman yahan bhi hai ke un par us bohat bade din ki haziri nihayat sakht dushwaar hogi. Sahih hadith mein hai jo shakhs is baat ki gawahi de ke Allah ek hai wahi mabood-e-barhaq hai us ke siva layak-e-ibadat aur koi nahi aur yeh ke Muhammad ﷺ Allah ke bande aur Rasool hain aur yeh ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) Allah ke bande aur us ke paighambar hain aur us ka kalma hain jise Hazrat Maryam (A.S) ki taraf dala tha aur us ke paas ki bheji hui rooh hain aur yeh ke jannat aur dozakh haq hai us ke khwah kaise hi aamal hon Allah use zaroor jannat mein pohanchayega.))
