Bukhari Muslim ki aur hadith mein hai ke napasand baaton ko sun kar sabr karne wala Allah se zyada koi nahi. Log us ki aulaad batlate hain aur woh unhein roziyan de raha hai aur aafiyat bhi. Khud Quran farmata hai (Wa ka-ayyin min qaryatin amlaitu laha wa hiya zalimatun thumma akhaztuha wa ilaynal-maseer) (Al-Hajj: 48) bohat si bastiyon wale woh hain jin ke zalim hone ke bawajood main ne unhein dheel di phir pakad liya aakhir lotna toh meri hi jaanib hai. Aur ayat mein hai ke zalim log apne aamal se Allah ko ghafil samjhein unhein jo mohlat hai woh us din tak hai jis din aankhein oopar chadh jayengi. Yahi farman yahan bhi hai ke un par us bohat bade din ki haziri nihayat sakht dushwaar hogi. Sahih hadith mein hai jo shakhs is baat ki gawahi de ke Allah ek hai wahi mabood-e-barhaq hai us ke siva layak-e-ibadat aur koi nahi aur yeh ke Muhammad ﷺ Allah ke bande aur Rasool hain aur yeh ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) Allah ke bande aur us ke paighambar hain aur us ka kalma hain jise Hazrat Maryam (A.S) ki taraf dala tha aur us ke paas ki bheji hui rooh hain aur yeh ke jannat aur dozakh haq hai us ke khwah kaise hi aamal hon Allah use zaroor jannat mein pohanchayega.))

Hazrat Isa ؑ ke bare mein mukhtalif aqwal. Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ se farmata hai ke Hazrat Isa ؑ ke waqia mein jin jin logon ka ikhtilaf tha un mein jo baat sahi thi woh itni hi thi jitni hum ne bayan farma di. Qaul ki dusri qirat qaul bhi hai. Ibn Masood ki qirat mein qaal-ul-haq hai. Qaul ka rafa zyada zahir hai jaise (AL-HAQQU MIR RABBIKA FALA TAKOUNANNA MINAL-MUMTARIN) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 147) mein. Yeh bayan farma kar ke Janab Isa ؑ Allah ke Nabi thay aur us ke bande phir apne nafs ki pakeezgi bayan farmata hai ke Allah ki shan se giri hui baat hai ke us ki aulad ho. Yeh jahil aalam jo afwahin ura rahe hain un se Allah Ta'ala pak aur door hai woh jis kaam ko karna chahta hai use saaman-e-asbab ki zarorat nahi parti farma deta hai ke hoja usi waqt woh kaam usi tarah hojata hai. Idhar hukam hua idhar cheez tayyar mojood. Jaise farman hai (INNA MASALA ISA INDALLAH KAMASHALI ADAMA KHALAQAHU MIN TURABIN THUMMA QALA LAHU KUN FAYAKOUN) (Surah (Al-Imran: 59) yani Hazrat Isa ؑ ki misal Allah ke nazdeek misal-e-Adam ؑ ke hai ke use mitti se bana kar farmaya hoja usi waqt woh hogaya yeh bilkul sach hai aur Allah ka farman tujhe is mein kisi qism ka shak na karna chahiye. Hazrat Isa ؑ ne apni qaum se yeh bhi farmaya ke mera aur tum sab ka Rab Allah Ta'ala hi hai tum sab usi ki ibadat karte raho. Seedhi rah jise main Allah ki janib se le kar aaya hoon yahi hai. Is ki tabedari karne wala hidayat par hai aur is ka khilaf karne wala gumrahi par hai yeh farman bhi Aap ka maan ki god se hi tha. Hazrat Isa ؑ ke apne bayan aur hukam ke khilaf baad walon ne lab-kushai ki aur un ke bare mein mukhtalif partyon ki shakal mein yeh log bat gaye. Chunacha Yahood ne kaha ke Hazrat Isa ؑ na'uzubillah walad-uz-zina hain, Allah ki la'anten un par hon ke unhon ne Allah ke ek behtareen Rasool par badtareen tuhmat lagayi. Aur kaha ke un ka yeh kalam waghera sab jadoo ke karishme thay. Isi tarah Nasara behak gaye kehne lage ke yeh to khud Allah hai yeh kalam Allah ka hi hai. Kisi ne kaha yeh Allah ka larka hai kisi ne kaha teen maboodon mein se ek hai haan ek jamalat ne waqia ke mutabiq kaha ke Aap Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain yahi qaul sahi hai. Ahl-e-Islam ka aqeeda Hazrat Isa ؑ ki nisbat yahi hai aur yahi taleem-e-Ilahi hai. Kehte hain ke Bani Israel ka majma jama hua hai aur apne mein se unhon ne chaar hazar aadmi chhante har qaum ne apna apna ek aalam paish kiya. Yeh waqia Hazrat Isa ؑ ke aasman par uth jaane ke baad ka hai. Yeh log aapas mein munazae hue ek to kehne lage yeh khud Allah tha jab tak us ne chaha zameen par raha jise chaha jalaya jise chaha mara phir aasman par chala gaya is giroh ko Yaqoobiyah kehte hain lekin aur teeno ne use jhutlaya aur kaha tu ne jhoot kaha ab do ne teesre se kaha achha tu keh tera kya khayal hai?

Us ne kaha woh Allah ke bete the is jama'at ka naam Nastouriya pada. Do jo reh gaye unhon ne kaha tu ne bhi ghalat kaha hai. Phir un do mein se ek ne kaha tum kaho us ne kaha main to yeh aqeedah rakhta hoon ke woh teen mein se ek hain ek to Allah jo ma'abood hai. Doosre yahi jo ma'abood hain teesre un ki walidah jo ma'abood hain. Yeh Israiliyah giroh hua aur yahi Nasraniyon ke badshah the un par Allah ki la'naten hain. Chouthe ne kaha tum sab jhoote ho Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam Allah ke bande hain aur Rasool the Allah hi ka kalma the aur us ke paas ki bheji hui rooh. Yeh log Musalman kehlaye aur yahi sachche the un mein se jis ke taabe jo the woh usi ke qool par ho gaye aur aapas mein khoob uchhle. Choonke sachche Islam wale har zamane mein tadaad mein kam hote hain un par yeh mal'oon chha gaye unhe daba liya unhe marna peetna aur qatal karna shuru kar diya. Aksar moarrikhin ka bayan hai ke Qustuntin badshah ne teen baar Isaaiyon ko jama kiya aakhri martaba ke ijtima mein un ke do hazaar ek sau sattar ulama jama hue the lekin yeh sab aapas mein Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam ke bare mein mukhtalif aara rakhte the. So kuch kehte to sattar aur hi kuch kehte, pachas kuch aur hi keh rahe the, saatht ka aqeedah kuch aur hi tha har ek ka khayal doosre se takra raha tha. Sab se badi jama'at teen sau aath ki thi. Badshah ne is taraf kasrat dekh kar kasrat ka saath diya. Maslihat-e-mulki isi mein thi ke is kaseer giroh ki tarafdari ki jaye lihaza us ki policy ne ise isi taraf mutawajjo kar diya. Aur us ne baaki ke sab logon ko nikalwa diya aur un ke liye Amanat-e-Kubra ki rasm ijad ki jo darasal sab se zyada badtareen khiyanat hai. Ab masail-e-shari'ah ki kitabein in ulama se likhwayen aur bohat si rasumat-e-mulki aur zarooriyat-e-shahri ko sharai soorat mein daakhil kar liya. Bohat si nayi nayi baatein ijad keen aur asli deen-e-Maseehi ki soorat ko maskh kar ke ek majmooa murattab karaya aur ise logon mein raajh kar diya aur us waqt se deen-e-Maseehi yahi samjha jaane laga. Jab is par un sab ko razamand kar liya toh ab charon taraf kilisa, garje aur ibadat-khane banwane aur wahan in ulama ko bithane aur un ke zariye se is apni noumolood masihiyat ko phailane ki koshish mein lag gaya. Sham mein, Jazeerah mein, Room mein taqreeban barah hazaar aise makanat us ke zamane mein tameer karaye gaye us ki maan Hilana ne jis jagah sooli gadhi hui thi wahan ek qubba banwa diya aur us ki baqaidah parastish shuru ho gayi. Aur sab ne yaqeen kar liya ke Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam sooli par chadh gaye halanki un ka yeh qool ghalat hai Allah ne apne is moazzam bande ko apni jaanib aasmaan par chadha liya hai. Yeh Isaai mazhab kam ikhtilaf ki halki si misaal. Aise log jo Allah par jhoot iftara bandhein us ki aulaadein aur shareek-o-hissah daar sabit karein go woh duniya mein mohlat paalein lekin is azeem-ush-shaan din ko un ki halakat unhe charon taraf se gher legi aur barbaad ho jayenge. Allah Ta'ala nafarmanon ko go jaari azaab na kare lekin bilkul chhodta bhi nahin.

Qiyamat ka din dozahiyon ke liye yom-e-hasrat. Irshad hai ke aaj duniya mein yeh kuffar aankhein band kiye hue aur kaanon mein jaise thonse hue hain, lekin Qiyamat ke din unki aankhein khoob roshan ho jaayengi aur kaan bhi khoob khul jaayenge. Jaise Farman-e-Ilahi hai (Wa lau tara izil-mujrimuna nakisu ru'usihim inda rabbihim, rabbana absarna wa sami'na farji'na na'mal salihan inna muqinun) (Surah (As-Sajdah: 12). Kaash ke tu dekhta jab yeh gunahgaar log apne Rabb ke samne sharmsaar sar-nigoon khade hue keh rahe honge ke A Allah humne dekha suna. Al-kh. Pas us din na dekhna kaam aaye na sunna na hasrat-o-afsos karna na wavila karna. Agar yeh log apni aankhon aur apne kaanon se duniya mein kaam lekar Allah ke deen ko maan lete toh aaj unhein hasrat-o-afsos na karna padta, us din aankhein kholenge aur aaj andhe behre bane phirte hain na hidayat ko talab karte hain na dekhte hain na bhali baatein sunte hain na maante hain. Makhlooq ko is hasrat waale din se khabardar kar dijiye jab ke tamam kaam faisal kar diye jaayenge, jannati jannat mein aur dozahi dozakh mein bhej diye jaayenge. Is hasrat-o-nadam ke din se yeh aaj ghafil ho rahe hain balke iman-o-yaqiin bhi rakhte hain. Aanhazrat ﷺ farmate hain jannatiyon ke jannat mein aur dozahiyon ke dozakh mein chale jaane ke baad maut ko ek bhed ki shakl mein laya jayega aur jannat dozakh ke darmiyan khada kiya jayega phir ahl-e-jannat se pucha jayega ke ise jaante ho? Woh dekh kar kahenge ke haan yeh maut hai, dozahiyon se bhi yeh sawal hoga aur woh bhi yehi jawab denge. Ab hukm hoga aur maut ko zibah kar diya jayega aur nida kar dijiye jayegi ke ahl-e-jannat tumhare liye hamesha maut nahi aur ahl-e-jahannam tumhare liye bhi ab hamesha maut nahi. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne yehi ayat (Wa anzirhum) al-kh, tilawat farmayi. Aur aap ne ishara kiya aur farmaya ahl-e-duniya ghaflat-e-duniya mein hain (Musnad Imam Ahmad). Ibn Mas'ud ؓ ne ek waqia mutawwal bayan karte hue farmaya ke har shakhs apne dozakh aur jannat ke ghar ko dekh raha hoga, woh din hi hasrat-o-afsos ka hai, jahannami apne jannati ghar ko dekh raha hoga aur usse kaha jata hoga ke agar tum amal karte toh tumhein yeh jagah milti, woh hasrat-o-afsos karne lagenge, idhar jannatiyon ko unka jahannam ka ghar dikha kar farmaya jayega ke agar Allah ka ehsan tum par na hota toh tum yahan hote. Aur riwayat mein hai ke maut ko zibah karke jab hamesha ke liye aawaz laga di jayegi, us waqt jannati toh is qadar khush honge ke agar Allah na bachaye toh maare khushi ke mar jaayenge aur jahannami is qadar ranjida ho kar cheekhenge ke agar maut hoti toh halak ho jaate. Pas is ayat ka yehi matlab hai yeh waqt hasrat ka bhi hoga aur kaam ke khatma ka bhi yehi hoga. Pas is ayat ka matlab hai yeh waqt hasrat bhi hoga aur kaam ka bhi yehi hoga.

Pas Yaum-ul-Hasrat bhi Qiyamat ke namon mein se ek naam hai, chunancha aur aayat mein hai: An taqula nafsun ya hasrata 'ala ma farrattu fi janb-i-lahi wa in kuntu laminas-sakhirin (Surah (Az-Zumar: 56). Phir bataya ke Khaliq Malik Mutasarrif Allah hi hai, sab usi ki malkiyat hai aur sab ko fana hai, baqi sirf Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu hi hai, koi malkiyat aur tasarruf ka sacha dawe-dar bajay is ke koi nahi. Tamam khalq ka waris hakim wahi hai, us ki zaat zulm se paak hai. Khalifa-e-Islam Amir-ul-Mominin Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ؒ ne Abdul Hamid bin Abdur Rahman ko Koofe mein khat likha, jis mein likha: Hamd-o-Salawat ke baad, Allah ne roz-e-awwal se hi sari makhlooq par fana likh di hai. Sab ko us ki taraf pahunchna hai, us ne apni nazil karda sachi kitab mein, jise apne ilm se mehfooz kiye hue hai aur jis ki nighebani apne farishton se kara raha hai, likh diya hai ke zameen ka aur us ke upar jo hain un ka waris wahi hai aur usi ki taraf lautaye jayenge.))

Sab ko us ki taraf pahunchna hai, us ne apni nazil karda sachi kitab mein, jise apne ilm se mehfooz kiye hue hai aur jis ki nighebani apne farishton se kara raha hai, likh diya hai ke zameen ka aur us ke upar jo hain un ka waris wahi hai aur usi ki taraf lautaye jayenge.))

Buton ki puja. Mushrikeen-e-Makkah jo بت پرست hain aur apne aap ko Khalilullah ka mutabie khayal karte hain un ke samne Ae Nabi ﷺ khud Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ka waqya bayan kijiye. Is sachey Nabi ne apne baap ki bhi parwah na ki aur us ke samne bhi haq ko wazeh kar diya aur usay بت پرستی se roka. Saaf kaha ke kyun in buton ki puja paat kar rahe ho jo na nafa pohcha saken na zarar. Farmaya ke main beshak aap ka bacha hoon lekin Allah ka ilm jo mere paas hai aap ke paas nahi aap meri ittiba kijiye main aap ko rah-e-rast dikhaunga buraiyon se bacha doonga. Aba ji yeh بت پرستی to shaitan ki tabadari hai wahi is ki rah samjhata hai aur wahi is se khush hota hai. Jaise Surah Yasin mein hai (Alam ahad alaikum ya bani adama an la tabudus shaitana innahu lakum aduwwun mubeen 60) (Yasin: 60), Allah Ta'ala farmayega ke ae insano kya main ne tum se ahad nahi liya tha ke shaitan ki ibadat na karna woh tumhara khula dushman hai aur ayat mein hai (In yadouna min dunihai illa inathan wa in yadouna illa shaitanammareeda) (An-Nisa: 117), yeh log to auraton ko pukarte hain aur Allah ko chhorte hain darasal yeh sarkash shaitan ke pukarne wale hain aap ne farmaya shaitan Allah ka nafarman hai, mukhalif hai, is ki farmabardari se takabbur karne wala hai, isi wajah se randa-e-dargah hua hai agar tu ne bhi is ki itaat ki to woh apni halat par tujhe bhi pohcha dega. Aba jaan aap ke is shirk-o-isyan ki wajah se mujhe to khauf hai ke kahin aap par Allah ka koi azab na aa jaye aur aap shaitan ke dost aur is ke sathi na ban jayein aur Allah ki madad aur is ka sath aap se chhoot na jaye. Dekho shaitan khud be-kas be-bas hai is ki tabadari aap ko buri jagah pohcha degi. Jaise farman-e-bari hai (Tallahi laqad arsalna ila umamin min qablika fazayyana lahumush shaitanu a'malahum fahuwa waliyyuhumul yauma wa lahum azabun aleem 63) (An-Nahl: 63) yani yeh yaqeeni aur qasmiya baat hai ke tujh se pehle ki ummaton ki taraf bhi hum ne rasool bheje lekin shaitan ne un ki badaamaliyan unhain mazeen kar ke dikhlain aur wahi un ka sathi ban gaya lekin kaam kuch na aaya aur qiyamat ke din azab-e-aleem mein phans gaye.

Baap ki Ibrahim (A.S) ko dhamki. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke is tarah samjhane par un ke baap ne jo jahalat ka jawab diya woh bayan ho raha hai ke us ne kaha Ibrahim tu mere ma'aboodon se bezar hai, un ki ibadat se tujhe inkar hai achha sun rakh agar tu apni is harkat se baaz na aaya, unhein bura kahta raha, un ki aib-joi aur unhein gaaliyan dene se na roka to main tujhe sangsar kar dunga. Mujhe to takleef na de na mujh se kuch keh. Yehi behtar hai ke tu salamati ke sath mujh se alag ho jaye warna main tujhe saza dunga. Mujh se to tu ab hamesha ke liye gaya-guzra. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne farmaya achha khush raho meri taraf se aap ko koi takleef na pahunchegi kyunke aap mere walid hain balki main Allah Ta'ala se dua karunga ke woh aap ko naik taufeeq de aur aap ke gunah bakhsh de. Mominon ka yehi shiwah hota hai ke woh jahiloon se bhadte nahi jaise ke Quran mein hai (Wa iza khatabahumul-jahiloona qaloo salama) (Al-Furqan: 63) jahiloon se jab un ka khitab hota hai to woh kahte hain ke salam. Aur aayat mein hai laghwo baton se woh munh pher lete hain aur kahte hain ke hamare aamal hamare sath tumhare aamal tumhare sath tum par salam ho. Hum jahiloon ke darpey nahi hote. Phir farmaya ke mera Rab mere sath bahut meharban hai usi ki meharbani hai ke mujhe iman-o-ikhlas ki hidayat ki. Mujhe us se apni dua ki qubooliyat ki umeed hai usi waade ke mutabiq aap un ke liye bakhshish talab karte rahe. Sham ki hijrat ke baad bhi Masjid-e-Haram banane ke baad bhi aap ke haan aulaad ho jaane ke baad bhi aap kahte rahe ke Aye Allah mujhe mere maan-baap ko aur tamam iman walon ko hisab ke qaim hone ke din bakhsh de. Aakhir Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se wahi aayi ke mushrikon ke liye istighfar na karo. Aap hi ki iqta mein pehle pehel musalman bhi ibtida-e-islam ke zamane mein apne qarabat-dar mushrikon ke liye talab-e-bakhshish ki duayein karte rahe. Aakhir aayat nazil hui ke beshak Ibrahim (A.S) qabil-e-ittibaa hain lekin is baab mein un ka fe'l is qabil nahi aur aayat mein farmaya (Ma kana lin-nabiyyi wal-lazeena amanoo an yastaghfiru lil-mushrikeena wa law kanoo uli qurba mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahum annahum ashabul-jaheem) (At-Tawbah: 113), yaani Nabi ko aur imandaron ko mushrikon ke liye istighfar na karna chahiye al-akh. Aur farmaya ke Ibrahim ka ye istighfar sirf is bina par tha ke aap apne walid se is ka wada kar chuke the lekin jab aap par wazeh ho gaya ke woh Allah ka dushman hai to aap us se bari ho gaye. Ibrahim to bade hi Allah dost aur halm wale the. Phir farmate hain ke main tum sab se aur tumhare in tamam ma'aboodon se alag hoon, main sirf Allah wahid ka aabid hoon, us ki ibadat mein kisi ko shareek nahi karta main faqat usi se duayein aur iltijayein karta hoon aur mujhe yaqeen hai ke main apni duaaon mein mahroom na rahunga.

Waqia bhi یہی hai aur yahan par lafzi 'asa' yaqeen ke معنوں mein hai is liye ke aap An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad Syed-ul-Anbiya hain (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam).

La talluq hone ka a'lan. Khalilullah (Alaihis Salam) maa baap ko, rishtey kanbe ko, qoum-o-mulk ko Allah ke deen par qurban kar chuke, sab se yak-taraf ho gaye, apni baraat aur alahadgi ka a'lan kar diya toh Allah ne unki nasal jari kar di. Aap ke haan Hazrat Ishaq (Alaihis Salam) paida hue aur Hazrat Ishaq ke haan Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) hue. Jaise farman hai: (Wa ya'quba nafilatan wa kullan ja'alna salihin) (Al-Anbiya: 72) aur ayat mein hai: (Wa min wara'i ishaqa ya'quba) (Hud: 71) yaani Ishaq ke peechhe Yaqub. Pas Hazrat Ishaq, Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ke walid the, jaise Surah Baqarah ki ayat (Am kuntum shuhada'a iz hazara ya'qubal maut...) (Al-Baqarah: 133) mein saaf lafz hain ke Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ne apne inteqal ke waqt apne bachon se poocha ke tum sab mere baad kis ki ibadat karoge? Unhon ne jawab diya ke usi Allah ki jis ki ibadat aap karte hain aur aap ke walid Ibrahim, Ismail aur Ishaq (Alaihis Salam). Pas yahan matlab yeh hai ke hum ne uski nasal jari rakhi, beta diya, bete ke haan beta diya aur dono nabi bana kar aap ki aankhen thandi keen. Yeh zahir hai ke Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ke baad aap ke farzand Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) bhi nabi banaye gaye the, unka zikr yahan nahi kiya isliye ke Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ki nubuwwat ke waqt Khalilullah (Alaihis Salam) zinda na the. Yeh dono nubuwwatein yaani Hazrat Ishaq (Alaihis Salam) o Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ki nubuwwat aap ki zindagi mein aap ke samne thi isliye is ehsan ka zikr bayan farmaya. Rasulullah ﷺ se jab sawal hua ke sab se behtar shakhs kaun hai? Farmaya: Yusuf bin Yaqub nabiullah bin Ishaq nabiullah bin Ibrahim nabiullah wa Khalilullah. Aur hadith mein hai: Karim bin Karim bin Karim bin Karim, Yusuf bin Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim hain. Alaihimus Salatu Wassalam. Hum ne unhe apni bohat saari rahmaten dein aur unka zikr-e-khair aur sana-e-jameel ko duniya mein unke baad bulandi ke sath baaqi rakha yahan tak ke har mazhab wale unke gun gate hain. Fasalawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim ajma'in.

Khalis-e-Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam). Apne Khalil (Alaihis Salam) ka bayaan farma kar ab apne Kalim (Alaihis Salam) ka bayaan farmata hai. Mukhlisan ki doosri qira'at Mukhlisan bhi hai. Yani woh ba-ikhlas ibadat karne wale thay. Marwi hai ke hawariyon ne Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) se daryaft kiya ke Aiy Ruhullah hamein bataiye mukhlis shakhs kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo mahz Allah ke liye amal kare use is baat ki chahat na ho ke log meri tareefein karein. Doosri qira'at mein Mukhlisan hai yani Allah ke chida aur barguzida bande Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) jaise farman-e-bari hai (Inni istafaytuka ‘ala an-nasi birisalati wa bikalami fa khuz ma ataytuka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 144). Aap Allah ke Nabi aur Rasul thay paanch bare bare jalil-ul-qadr ulul-azam rasulon mein se ek aap hain yani, Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, aur Muhammad salawatullahi wa salamuhu ‘alaihim wa ‘ala sairil-anbiya'i ajma'in. Hum ne unhein mubarak pahaar Tur ki dayin janib se aawaz di sargoshi karte hue apne qareeb kar liya. Yeh waqia us waqt ka hai jab aap aag ki talaash mein Tur ki taraf yahan aag dekh kar barhe thay. Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera farmate hain is qadar qareeb ho gaye ke qalam ki aawaz sunne lage. Murad is se Taurat likhne ki qalam hai. Sudi kehte hain aasman mein gaye aur kalam-e-bari se musharraf huwe. Kehte hain unhi baaton mein yeh farman bhi hai ke Aiy Musa jab ke main tere dil ko shukr guzaar aur teri zaban ko apna zikr karne wali bana dun aur tujhe aisi biwi dun jo neki ke kaamo mein teri mu'avin ho to samajh le ke main ne tujh se koi bhalai utha nahi rakhi. Aur jise main yeh cheezein na dun samajh le ke use koi bhalai nahi mili. Un par ek mehrbani hum ne yeh bhi ki ke unke bhai Harun ko nabi bana kar unki imdad ke liye unke sath kar diya jaise ke aap ki chahat aur dua thi. Farmaya tha (Wa akhi Harunu huwa afsahu minni lisanan fa arsilhu ma'iya rid'an yusaddiquni inni akhafu an yukazzibun) (Surah (Al-Qasas: 34), aur aayat mein hai (Qala qad utita su'laka ya Musa) (Surah (Taha: 36) Musa tera sawal hum ne poora kar diya. Aap ki dua ke lafz yeh bhi وارد hain (Fa arsil ila Haruna) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 13), Harun ko bhi rasul bana alakh. Kehte hain ke is se zyada dua aur is se barh kar shafa'at kisi ne kisi ki duniya mein nahi ki. Hazrat Harun Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) se bare thay. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu ‘alaihimah.))))

Abu Al-Hajaz A.S. Hazrat Ismail bin Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihimas Salam) ka zikar-e-khair bayan ho raha hai, aap saare Hijaz ke baap hain jo nazr Allah ke naam ki mante the, jo ibadat karne ka irada karte the poori hi karte the. Har haq ada karte the, har waade ki wafa karte the. Aik shakhs se waada kiya ke falan jagah aap ko milunga wahan aap aa jana. Hasb-e-waada Hazrat Ismail A.S. wahan gaye lekin woh shakhs nahi aya tha. Aap us ke intezar mein wahin thahere rahe yahan tak ke aik din raat poora guzar gaya, ab us shakhs ko yaad aya us ne aakar dekha ke aap wahin intezar mein hain, poocha ke kya aap kal se yehin hain? Aap ne farmaya jab waada ho chuka tha toh phir main aap ke aaye bagair kaise hat sakta tha, us ne mazrat ki ke main bilkul bhool gaya tha. Sufyan Souri Rahimahullah toh kehte hain yehin intezar mein hi aap ko aik saal kamil guzar chuka tha. Ibn Shozab kehte hain wahin makan kar liya tha. Abdullah bin Al-Hama kehte hain ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ki nubuwwat se pehle main ne aap se kuch tijarti lain dain kiya tha, main chala gaya aur yeh keh gaya ke aap yehin thahariye main abhi wapas ata hoon, phir mujhe khayal hi na raha, woh din guzra, woh raat guzri, doosra din guzar gaya, teesre din mujhe khayal aya toh dekha aap wahin tashreef farma hain. Aap ne farmaya tum ne mujhe mashaqat mein daal diya, main aj teen din se yehin tumhara intezar karta raha. (Kharaiti) Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh us waade ka zikar hai jo aap ne biwaqt-e-zibh kiya tha ke abaji aap mujhe sabar karne wala payenge. Chanacha fi-al-waqi aap ne waade ki wafa ki aur sabr-o-bardasht se kaam liya. Waade ki wafa naik kaam hai aur waada khilafi bohat buri cheez hai. Quran-e-Kareem farmata hai: Iman walo woh baatein zaban se kyun nikalte ho jin par khud amal nahi karte, Allah ke nazdik yeh baat nihayat hi gazabnaki ki hai ke tum woh kaho jo na karo. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain, baaton mein jhoot, waada khilafi aur amanat mein khiyanat. In afton se Momin alag thalag hote hain, yahi waade ki sachai Hazrat Ismail A.S. mein thi aur yahi paak sifat Janab Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ mein bhi thi. Kabhi kisi se kisi waade ke khilaf aap ne nahi kiya. Aap ne aik martaba Abu Al-Aas bin Rabih ki tareef karte hue farmaya ke us ne mujh se jo baat ki sachi ki aur jo waada us ne mujh se kiya poora kiya. Hazrat Siddique Akbar ؓ ne takht-e-khilafat nabwi par qadam rakhte hi elan kar diya ke jis se Nabi Kareem ﷺ ne jo waada kiya ho main ise poora karne ke liye tayyar hoon aur Huzoor ﷺ par jis ka qarz ho main is ki adayigi ke liye mojood hoon. Chanacha Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah تشریف laye aur arz kiya ke mujh se Rasool Allah ne farmaya tha ke agar Bahrain ka maal aya toh main tujhe teen lapin bhar kar doonga. Hazrat Siddique Akbar ؓ ke paas jab Bahrain ka maal aya toh aap ne Hazrat Jabir ؓ ko bulwa kar farmaya lo lap bhar lo. Aap ki lap mein paanch so dirham aye, hukam diya ke teen lapon ke pandrah so dirham le lo. Phir Hazrat Ismail ka rasool nabi hona bayan farmaya.

Halanki Hazrat Ishaq (Alaihis Salam) ka sirf nabi hona bayaan farmaya gaya hai is se aap ki fazilat apne bhai par sabit hoti hai. Chunacha Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke aulaad-e-Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) mein se Allah ne Hazrat Ismail (Alaihis Salam) ko pasand farmaya, Al-Kh. Phir aap ki mazeed tareef bayaan ho rahi hai ke aap Allah ki ita'at par sabir thay aur apne gharane ko bhi yahi hukm farmate rehte thay. Yahi farman Allah Ta'ala ka Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ko hai (وَاْمُرْ اَهْلَكَ بالصَّلٰوةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۭ لَا نَسْــَٔــلُكَ رِزْقًا ۭ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۭ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ للتَّقْوٰى) (Surah (Taha: 132), Apne ahl-o-iyaal ko namaz ka hukm karta reh aur khud bhi is par mazbooti se aamil reh. Aur aayat mein hai (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا قُوْٓا اَنْفُسَكُمْ وَاَهْلِيْكُمْ نَارًا وَّقُوْدُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلٰۗىِٕكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُوْنَ اللّٰهَ مَآ اَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُوْنَ مَا يُؤْمَرُوْنَ) (Surah (At-Tahrim: 6), Aye iman walo! Apne aap ko aur apne ahl-o-iyaal ko us aag se bacha lo jis ka indhan insan hain aur patthar. Jahan azab karne wale farishte raham se khali zor-awar aur bare sakht hain. Na-mumkin hai ki Allah ke hukm ka woh khilaf karein balki jo un se kaha gaya hai usi ki tabedari mein mashghool hain. 

Pas musalmanon ko hukm-e-Ilahi ho raha hai ki apne ghar-baar ko Allah ki baaton ki hidayat karte rahein gunahon se rokte rahein yunhi be-taleem na chhodein ki woh jahannum ka luqma ban jayen. Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain us mard par Allah ka raham ho jo raat ko tahajjud parhne ke liye apne bistar se uthta hai phir apni biwi ko uthata hai aur agar woh nahi uthti toh us ke munh par pani chhirak kar use neend se bedar karta hai, us aurat par bhi Allah ki rehmat ho jo raat ko tahajjud parhne ke liye uthti hai phir apne miyan ko jagati hai aur na jage toh us ke munh par pani ka chhinta dalti hai (Abu Dawood, Ibn Majah). Aap ka farman hai ki jab insan raat ko jage aur apni biwi ko bhi jagaye aur dono do rakat bhi namaz ki ada kar lein toh Allah ke han Allah ka zikr karne wale mardon auraton mein dono ke naam likh liye jaate hain (Abu Dawood, Nasai, Ibn Majah).))

Hazrat Siddique Akbar ؓ ke paas jab Bahrain ka maal aya toh aap ne Hazrat Jabir ؓ ko bulwa kar farmaya lo lap bhar lo. Aap ki lap mein paanch so dirham aye, hukam diya ke teen lapon ke pandrah so dirham le lo. Phir Hazrat Ismail ka rasool nabi hona bayan farmaya.

Halanki Hazrat Ishaq (Alaihis Salam) ka sirf nabi hona bayaan farmaya gaya hai is se aap ki fazilat apne bhai par sabit hoti hai. Chunacha Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke aulaad-e-Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) mein se Allah ne Hazrat Ismail (Alaihis Salam) ko pasand farmaya, Al-Kh. Phir aap ki mazeed tareef bayaan ho rahi hai ke aap Allah ki ita'at par sabir thay aur apne gharane ko bhi yahi hukm farmate rehte thay. Yahi farman Allah Ta'ala ka Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ko hai (وَاْمُرْ اَهْلَكَ بالصَّلٰوةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۭ لَا نَسْــَٔــلُكَ رِزْقًا ۭ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۭ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ للتَّقْوٰى) (Surah (Taha: 132), Apne ahl-o-iyaal ko namaz ka hukm karta reh aur khud bhi is par mazbooti se aamil reh. Aur aayat mein hai (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا قُوْٓا اَنْفُسَكُمْ وَاَهْلِيْكُمْ نَارًا وَّقُوْدُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلٰۗىِٕكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُوْنَ اللّٰهَ مَآ اَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُوْنَ مَا يُؤْمَرُوْنَ) (Surah (At-Tahrim: 6), Aye iman walo! Apne aap ko aur apne ahl-o-iyaal ko us aag se bacha lo jis ka indhan insan hain aur patthar. Jahan azab karne wale farishte raham se khali zor-awar aur bare sakht hain. Na-mumkin hai ki Allah ke hukm ka woh khilaf karein balki jo un se kaha gaya hai usi ki tabedari mein mashghool hain. 

Pas musalmanon ko hukm-e-Ilahi ho raha hai ki apne ghar-baar ko Allah ki baaton ki hidayat karte rahein gunahon se rokte rahein yunhi be-taleem na chhodein ki woh jahannum ka luqma ban jayen. Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain us mard par Allah ka raham ho jo raat ko tahajjud parhne ke liye apne bistar se uthta hai phir apni biwi ko uthata hai aur agar woh nahi uthti toh us ke munh par pani chhirak kar use neend se bedar karta hai, us aurat par bhi Allah ki rehmat ho jo raat ko tahajjud parhne ke liye uthti hai phir apne miyan ko jagati hai aur na jage toh us ke munh par pani ka chhinta dalti hai (Abu Dawood, Ibn Majah). Aap ka farman hai ki jab insan raat ko jage aur apni biwi ko bhi jagaye aur dono do rakat bhi namaz ki ada kar lein toh Allah ke han Allah ka zikr karne wale mardon auraton mein dono ke naam likh liye jaate hain (Abu Dawood, Nasai, Ibn Majah).))

Hazrat Idris A.S ka ta'aruf. Hazrat Idris A.S ka bayan ho raha hai ke aap sache Nabi thay, Allah ke khas bande thay. Aap ko hum ne buland makan par utha liya. Sahih Hadith ke hawaley se pehle guzar chuka hai ke chothay aasman par Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Idris A.S se mulaqat ki. Is ayat ki tafsir mein Hazrat Imam Ibn Jarir R.H ne ek ajib-o-gharib asar وارد kiya hai ke Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne Hazrat Ka'ab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se sawal kiya ke is ayat ka matlab kya hai? Aap ne farmaya ke Hazrat Idris A.S ke paas wahi aayi ke kal aulad-e-Adam ke naik aamal ke barabar sirf teray naik aamal main apni taraf har roz chadhata hoon. Is par aap ne zikar kiya mere paas yun wahi aayi hai ab tum Malik-ul-Maut se kaho ke woh meri mout mein takher karein toh main naik aamal mein aur aur badh jaun. Is farishte ne aap ko apne paron mein bitha kar aasman par chadhaya jab chothay aasman par aap pahuche toh Malik-ul-Maut ko dekha, farishte ne aap se Hazrat Idris A.S ki babat sifarish ki toh Malik-ul-Maut ne farmaya woh kahan hain? Us ne kaha yeh hain mere bazu par baithe hue, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah mujhe yahan is aasman par is ki rooh ke qabz karne ka hukum ho raha hai, chunache usi waqt un ki rooh qabz kar li gayi. Yeh hain is ayat ke mani. Lekin yeh yaad rahe ke Ka'ab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka yeh bayan Israiliyat mein se hai aur is ke ba'az mein nukarat hai, Wallahu A'alam. Yahi riwayat aur sanad se hai is mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ne ba-zariya us farishte ko puchwaya tha ke meri umar kitni baqi hai? Aur riwayat mein hai ke farishte ke is sawal par Malik-ul-Maut ne jawab diya ke main dekh loon, dekh kar farmaya sirf ek ankh ki palak ke barabar. Ab jo farishta apne par tale dekhta hai toh Hazrat Idris A.S ki rooh parwaz ho chuki thi. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se marwi hai ke aap darzi thay, sui ke ek ek tanke par SubhanAllah kehte. Sham se un se ziyada naik amal aasman par kisi ke na chadhate. Mujahid R.H toh kehte hain Hazrat Idris A.S aasmano par chadhaye gaye. Aap mare nahi balki Hazrat Isa A.S ki tarah be-mout utha liye gaye aur wahin intiqal farma gaye. Hasan R.H kehte hain buland makan se murad Jannat hai.

Anbiya ki jama'at ka zikr. Farman-e-Ilahi hai ke yeh hai jama'at-e-anbiya ya'ni jin ka zikr is surat mein hai ya pehle guzra hai ya ba'ad mein aayega, yeh log Allah ke in'am yafta hain. Pas yahan shakhsiyat se jins ki taraf istitrad hai. Yeh hain aulad-e-Adam se ya'ni Hazrat Idris Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaih aur aulad se un ki jo Hazrat Nuh ke sath kashti mein sawar kara diye gaye the is se murad Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah Alaih Salawatullah hain. Aur zurriyat-e-Ibrahim A.S se murad Hazrat Ishaq, Hazrat Ya'qub, Hazrat Ismail hain aur zurriyat-e-Israil se murad Hazrat Musa, Hazrat Harun, Hazrat Zakariya, Hazrat Yahya aur Hazrat Isa hain Alaihimus Salam. Yehi qaul hai Hazrat Suddi R.H aur Ibn Jarir R.H ka. Isi liye un ke nasab judagana bayaan farmaye gaye ke go aulad-e-Adam mein sab hain magar un mein ba'z woh bhi hain jo un buzurgon ki nasl se nahi jo Hazrat Nuh A.S ke sathi the kyunke Hazrat Idris to Hazrat Nuh A.S ke dada the. 

Mein kehta hoon bazahir yehi theek hai ke Hazrat Nuh A.S ke upar ke nasab mein Allah ke paighambar Hazrat Idris A.S hain. Haan ba'z logon ka khayal hai ke Hazrat Idris Bani Israel ke nabi hain. Yeh kehte hain ke Me'raj wali hadith mein Hazrat Idris ka bhi Huzoor ﷺ se yeh kehna marwi hai ke marhabah ho bani saleh aur bhai saleh ko marhabah ho. To bhai saleh kaha na ke saleh walad jaise ke Hazrat Ibrahim aur Hazrat Adam (Alaihimas Salam) ne kaha tha. Marwi hai ke Hazrat Idris A.S Hazrat Nuh A.S se pehle ke hain. Aap ne apni kaum se farmaya tha ke La ilaha illallah ke qaail aur mu'taqideen ban jao phir jo chaho karo lekin unhon ne is ka inkar kiya Allah Azzawajal ne un sab ko halak kar diya. 

Hum ne is aayat ko jins-e-anbiya ke liye qarar diya hai is ki daleel Surah An'am ki woh aayatein hain jin mein Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihissalam, Hazrat Ishaq A.S, Hazrat Ya'qub A.S, Hazrat Nuh A.S, Hazrat Dawud A.S, Hazrat Sulaiman A.S, Hazrat Ayyub A.S, Hazrat Yusuf A.S, Hazrat Musa A.S, Hazrat Harun A.S, Hazrat Zakariya A.S, Hazrat Yahya Alaihissalam, Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Ilyas A.S, Hazrat Ismail A.S, Hazrat Yunus A.S, waghera ka zikr hai aur taarif karne ke baad farmaya: (Ula'ikallazeena hadallaho fabihudahum-uqtadih, qul la as'alukum alaihi ajra, in huwa illa zikra lil-aalameen) (Al-An'am: 90) Yehi woh log hain jinhein Allah ne hidayat di to abhi un ki hidayat ki iqtida kar aur yeh bhi farmaya hai ke nabiyon mein se ba'z ke waqiat hum ne bayaan kar diye hain aur ba'z ke waqiat tum tak pohnche hi nahi. 

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Mujahid R.H ne Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se sawal kiya ke kya Surah Suad mein sajda hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, phir isi aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya tumhare Nabi ﷺ ko un ki iqtida ka hukm kiya gaya hai aur Hazrat Dawud A.S bhi muqtada nabiyon mein se hain.

Farman hai ke un paighambaron ke samne jab Kalamullah Sharif ki ayatein tilawat ki jati thin toh uske dalail-o-barahin par khushoo-o-khuzoo ke sath Allah Ta'ala ka shukr-o-ehsan mante hue rote gurgirate sajde mein gir parte the, isi liye is ayat par sajda karne ka hukm ulama ka muttafiq alaih masla hai taake un paighambaron ki itbaa aur iktida ho jaye. Amir-ul-Momineen Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne Surah Maryam ki tilawat ki aur jab is ayat par pahuche toh sajda kiya, phir farmaya sajda toh kiya lekin woh rona kahan se layein? (Ibn Abi Hatim aur Ibn Jarir)

Hudud-e-Ilahi ke muhافظ۔ Nek logon ka khususan Anbiya-e-Kiram (Alaihimas Salam) ka zikr kiya jo hudud-e-Ilahi ke muhافظ, nek aamal ke namune badiyon se bachte hain. Ab bure logon ka zikr ho raha hai ki unke baad ke zamane wale aise hue ki woh namazon tak se be-parwah ban gaye aur jab namaz jaise fareze ki ahmiyat ko bhula baithe toh zahir hai ki aur wahiyaat ki woh kya parwah karenge? Kyunki namaz toh deen ki bunyad hai aur tamam aamal se afzal-o-behtar hai. Yeh log nafsani khwahishon ke peeche pad gaye, duniya ki zindagi par itminan se reejh gaye, unhe Roz-e-Qayamat sakht khasara hoga, bade ghate mein rahenge. Namaz ke zaya karne se murad ya toh use bilkul hi chhod dena baithna hai. Isi liye Imam Ahmad (Rahimahullah) aur bahut se salaf-o-khalaf ka mazhab hai ki namaz ka tarik kafir hai. Yehi ek qaul Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (Rahimahullah) ka bhi hai kyunki hadith mein hai ki bande aur shirk ke darmiyan namaz ka chhodna hai. Dusri hadith mein hai ki hum mein aur un mein farq namaz ka hai jisne namaz chhod di woh kafir ho gaya. Is masle ko tafseel se bayan karne ka yeh maqam nahi. Ya namaz ke tark se murad namaz ke waqton ki sahi taur par pabandi ka na karna hai kyunki tark-e-namaz toh kufr hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood (R.A) se daryaft kiya gaya ki Quran-e-Karim mein namaz ka zikr bahut zyada hai, kahin namazon mein susti karne walon ke azab ka bayan hai, kahin namaz ki mudawamat ka farman hai, kahin muhافظat ka. Aap ne farmaya unse murad waqton mein susti na karna aur waqton ki pabandi karna hai. Logon ne kaha hum toh samajhte the ki isse murad namazon ka chhod dena aur na chhod dena hai. Aap ne farmaya yeh toh kufr hai. Hazrat Masruq (Rahimahullah) farmate hain panchhon namazon ki hifazat karne wala ghafilon mein nahi likha jata, unka zaya karna apne aap ko halak karna hai aur unka zaya karna unke waqton ki pabandi na karna hai. Khalifatul Muslimeen Amirul Mumineen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (Rahimahullah) ne is ayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ki isse murad sare se namaz chhod dena nahi balki namaz ke waqt ko zaya kar dena hai. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yeh badtareen log qareeb-e-qayamat aayenge jab ki is ummat ke saleh log baaki na rahe honge us waqt yeh log janwaro ki tarah koudte phandte phirenge. Ata bin Abi Rabah (Rahimahullah) yehi farmate hain ki yeh log aakhri zamane mein honge. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yeh is ummat ke log honge jo chopayon aur gadhoon ki manind raston mein uchhal koud karenge aur Allah Ta'ala se jo aasmaan mein hai bilkul na darenge aur na logon se sharmayenge. Ibn Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya yeh na-khalaf log saath saal ke baad honge jo namazon ko zaya kar denge aur shahwat-raniyon mein lag jayenge aur Roz-e-Qayamat khamyaza bhugtenge. Phir unke baad woh nalaeeq log aayenge jo Quran ki tilawat toh karenge lekin unke halq se neeche na utrega. Yaad rakho qari teen qisam ke hote hain: Mumin, Munafiq aur Fajir.

Ravi-e-Hadith Hazrat Waleed se jab un ke shagird ne is ki tafseel poochhi toh aap ne farmaya: Imaan-dar toh is ki tasdeeq karenge, nifaq wale is par aqeeda nah rakhenge aur faajir is se apni shikam-puri karega. Ibn Abi Hatim ki aik ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Mai Ayesha (R.A) Ashab-e-Suffah ke liye jab kuch khairat bhjwaatin toh keh deteen ke Barbari mard-o-aurat ko nah dena kyunki maine Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke yehi woh nakhlaf hain jin ka zikr is ayat mein hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka farmaan hai ke murad is se Maghrib ke baadshah hain jo bad-tareen baadshah hain. Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ahbar (R.H) farmate hain: Allah ki qasam! Main munafiqon ke wasf Quran-e-Kareem mein pata hoon; yeh nashe peene wale, namazein chhodne wale, shatranj chausar waghaira khelne wale, Isha ki namazon ke waqt so jaane wale, khane peene mein mubaligha aur takalluf karke peto ban kar khane wale, jama'aton ko chhodne wale. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain: Masjidein un logon se khaali nazar aati hain aur baithkein ba-ronaq bani hui hain. Abu Shahab Ata Roomi (R.H) farmate hain: Hazrat Dawood (A.S) par wahi aayi ke apne sathiyon ko hoshiyar kar de ke woh apni nafsani khwahishon se baaz rahein, jin ke dil khwahishon ke pheir mein rehte hain, main un ki aqalon par parda daal deta hoon, jab koi banda shahwat mein andha hojata hai toh sab se halki saza mein use yeh deta hoon ke apni ita'at se use mehroom kar deta hoon. Musnad Ahmad mein hai: Mujhe apni Ummat mein do cheezon ka bahut hi khauf hai, aik toh yeh ke log jhoot ke aur banaw ke aur shahwat ke peeche pad jayenge aur namazon ko chhod baithenge, doosre yeh ke munafiq log duniya dikhawe ke Quran ke aamil ban kar sachhe momino-se ladenge jhagdenge. Ghai ke maani khusran aur nuqsan aur burai ke hain. Ibn Masood (R.A) se marwi hai ke Ghai Jahannam ki aik wadi ka naam hai jo bahut gehri hai aur nihayat sakht azabon wali, is mein khoon peep bhara hua hai. Ibn Jareer mein hai Luqman bin Aamir farmate hain: Main Hazrat Abu Umamah Sadi bin Ajlan Bahili (R.A) ke paas gaya aur un se iltimas ki ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hui hadith mujhe sunayein. Aap ne farmaya: Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke agar das oqiya ke wazan ka koi patthar Jahannam ke kinaare se Jahannam mein phenka jaye toh woh pachaas saal tak toh Jahannam ki teh mein nahi pahunch sakta, phir woh Ghai aur Asam mein pahunchega. Ghai aur Asam Jahannam ke neeche ke do kuwein hain jahan dozakhiyon ka lahoo peep jama hota hai. Ghai ka zikr ayat (Fasaufa yalqawna ghayya) (Maryam: 59) mein hai aur Asam ka zikr ayat (Wa man yaf'al dhalika yalqa asama) (Al-Furqan: 68) mein hai. Is hadith ko farmaan-e-Rasool se riwayat karna munkar hai aur yeh hadith ki ro se bhi ghareeb hai.

Phir farmata hai haan jo un kaamon se tauba karle yaani namazon ki susti aur khwahish-e-nafsani ki pairwi chhod de Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba ko qubool farma lega us ki aaqibat sanwaar dega usay jahannam se bacha kar jannat mein pohanchaye ga, tauba apne se pehle ke tamam gunahon ko maaf kara deti hai. Aur hadees mein hai ke tauba karne wala aisa hai jaise begunaah. Yeh log jo nekiyan karein un ke ajr unhein milenge kisi ek neki ka sawab kam na hoga. Tauba se pehle ke gunahon par koi pakar na hogi. Yeh hai karam us Kareem ka aur yeh hai hilm us Haleem ka ke tauba ke baad us gunah ko bilkul mita deta hai na-pwaid kar deta hai. Surah Furqan mein gunahon ka zikr farma kar un ki sazaon ka bayan kar ke phir istisna kiya aur farmaya ke Allah Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai.

Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yeh badtareen log qareeb-e-qayamat aayenge jab ki is ummat ke saleh log baaki na rahe honge us waqt yeh log janwaro ki tarah koudte phandte phirenge. Ata bin Abi Rabah (Rahimahullah) yehi farmate hain ki yeh log aakhri zamane mein honge. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yeh is ummat ke log honge jo chopayon aur gadhoon ki manind raston mein uchhal koud karenge aur Allah Ta'ala se jo aasmaan mein hai bilkul na darenge aur na logon se sharmayenge. Ibn Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya yeh na-khalaf log saath saal ke baad honge jo namazon ko zaya kar denge aur shahwat-raniyon mein lag jayenge aur Roz-e-Qayamat khamyaza bhugtenge. Phir unke baad woh nalaeeq log aayenge jo Quran ki tilawat toh karenge lekin unke halq se neeche na utrega. Yaad rakho qari teen qisam ke hote hain: Mumin, Munafiq aur Fajir.

Ravi-e-Hadith Hazrat Waleed se jab un ke shagird ne is ki tafseel poochhi toh aap ne farmaya: Imaan-dar toh is ki tasdeeq karenge, nifaq wale is par aqeeda nah rakhenge aur faajir is se apni shikam-puri karega. Ibn Abi Hatim ki aik ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Mai Ayesha (R.A) Ashab-e-Suffah ke liye jab kuch khairat bhjwaatin toh keh deteen ke Barbari mard-o-aurat ko nah dena kyunki maine Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke yehi woh nakhlaf hain jin ka zikr is ayat mein hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka farmaan hai ke murad is se Maghrib ke baadshah hain jo bad-tareen baadshah hain. Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ahbar (R.H) farmate hain: Allah ki qasam! Main munafiqon ke wasf Quran-e-Kareem mein pata hoon; yeh nashe peene wale, namazein chhodne wale, shatranj chausar waghaira khelne wale, Isha ki namazon ke waqt so jaane wale, khane peene mein mubaligha aur takalluf karke peto ban kar khane wale, jama'aton ko chhodne wale. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain: Masjidein un logon se khaali nazar aati hain aur baithkein ba-ronaq bani hui hain. Abu Shahab Ata Roomi (R.H) farmate hain: Hazrat Dawood (A.S) par wahi aayi ke apne sathiyon ko hoshiyar kar de ke woh apni nafsani khwahishon se baaz rahein, jin ke dil khwahishon ke pheir mein rehte hain, main un ki aqalon par parda daal deta hoon, jab koi banda shahwat mein andha hojata hai toh sab se halki saza mein use yeh deta hoon ke apni ita'at se use mehroom kar deta hoon. Musnad Ahmad mein hai: Mujhe apni Ummat mein do cheezon ka bahut hi khauf hai, aik toh yeh ke log jhoot ke aur banaw ke aur shahwat ke peeche pad jayenge aur namazon ko chhod baithenge, doosre yeh ke munafiq log duniya dikhawe ke Quran ke aamil ban kar sachhe momino-se ladenge jhagdenge. Ghai ke maani khusran aur nuqsan aur burai ke hain. Ibn Masood (R.A) se marwi hai ke Ghai Jahannam ki aik wadi ka naam hai jo bahut gehri hai aur nihayat sakht azabon wali, is mein khoon peep bhara hua hai. Ibn Jareer mein hai Luqman bin Aamir farmate hain: Main Hazrat Abu Umamah Sadi bin Ajlan Bahili (R.A) ke paas gaya aur un se iltimas ki ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hui hadith mujhe sunayein. Aap ne farmaya: Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke agar das oqiya ke wazan ka koi patthar Jahannam ke kinaare se Jahannam mein phenka jaye toh woh pachaas saal tak toh Jahannam ki teh mein nahi pahunch sakta, phir woh Ghai aur Asam mein pahunchega. Ghai aur Asam Jahannam ke neeche ke do kuwein hain jahan dozakhiyon ka lahoo peep jama hota hai. Ghai ka zikr ayat (Fasaufa yalqawna ghayya) (Maryam: 59) mein hai aur Asam ka zikr ayat (Wa man yaf'al dhalika yalqa asama) (Al-Furqan: 68) mein hai. Is hadith ko farmaan-e-Rasool se riwayat karna munkar hai aur yeh hadith ki ro se bhi ghareeb hai.

Phir farmata hai haan jo un kaamon se tauba karle yaani namazon ki susti aur khwahish-e-nafsani ki pairwi chhod de Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba ko qubool farma lega us ki aaqibat sanwaar dega usay jahannam se bacha kar jannat mein pohanchaye ga, tauba apne se pehle ke tamam gunahon ko maaf kara deti hai. Aur hadees mein hai ke tauba karne wala aisa hai jaise begunaah. Yeh log jo nekiyan karein un ke ajr unhein milenge kisi ek neki ka sawab kam na hoga. Tauba se pehle ke gunahon par koi pakar na hogi. Yeh hai karam us Kareem ka aur yeh hai hilm us Haleem ka ke tauba ke baad us gunah ko bilkul mita deta hai na-pwaid kar deta hai. Surah Furqan mein gunahon ka zikr farma kar un ki sazaon ka bayan kar ke phir istisna kiya aur farmaya ke Allah Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai.

Allah Ta'ala ke waade bar-haq hain. Jin jannaton mein gunahon se tauba karne wale dakhil honge yeh jannatein hamesha wali hongi jin ka ghaibana waada un se un ka Rab kar chuka hai. In jannaton ko unhon ne dekha nahi lekin taham dekhne se bhi zyada unhe un par yaqeen-o-imaan hai. Baat bhi yeh hai ki Allah ke waade atal hote hain, woh haqaiq hain jo samne aakar hi rahenge. Na Allah waada-khilafi kare na waade ko badle, yeh log wahan zaroor pohchaye jayenge aur use zaroor payenge. 

Matia ke maani atiya ke bhi aate hain aur yeh bhi hai ki jahan hum jaye woh hamare paas aa hi gaya. Jaise kehte hain mujh par pachaas saal aaye ya main pachaas saal ko pohcha. Matlab dono jumlon ka ek hi hota hai. Na-mumkin hai ki in jannaton mein koi lagho aur na-pasandeeda kalam un ke kaano mein pade. Sirf mubarak-salamat ki dhoom hogi. Charon taraf se aur khususan farishton ki pak zabani yehi mubarak sadaayein kaan mein goonjti rahengi. Jaise Surah Waqiah mein hai: (Lā yasma‘ūna fīhā laghwaw wa lā ta’thīmā - 56. (Al-Waqiah: 25) Wahan koi behoodah aur khilaf-e-tab'a sukhan na sunenge bajuz salam aur salamati ke. Yeh istisna-e-munqati' hai. 

Subh-o-sham pak, tayyib, umdah, khush-zaiqa roziyan bila takalluf-o-takleef, be-mashaqqat-o-zahmat chali aayengi. Lekin yeh na samjha jaye ki jannat mein bhi din raat honge, nahi balke un anwar se un waqton ko jannati pehchan lenge jo Allah ki taraf se muqarrar hain. Chunacha Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: "Pehli jamaat jo jannat mein jayegi un ke chehre chaudhwein raat ke chand jaise roshan aur noorani honge. Na wahan unhe thook aayega na naak aayegi na peshab-pakhana. Un ke bartan aur furniture sone ke honge, un ka bakhoor khushbodar agar hoga, un ke paseene mushk-boo honge, har ek jannati mard ki do biwiyaan to aisi hongi ki un ke pande ki safai se un ki pandliyon ki nali ka goda tak bahar nazar aaye." 

In sab jannaton mein na to kisi ko kisi se adawat hogi na bughz, sab ek dil honge. Koi ikhtilaf baham digar na hoga. Subh-o-sham tasbeeh mein guzrenge. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: "Shaheed log us waqt jannat ke ek nahar ke kinare jannat ke darwaze ke paas surkh rang qubbun mein hain, subh-o-sham rozi pohchaye jaate hain." (Musnad) 

Pas subh-o-sham ba-itebar-e-duniya ke hai, wahan raat nahi balke har waqt noor ka samaan hai. Parde gir jane aur darwaze band ho jane se ahl-e-jannat waqt-e-sham ko, isi tarah pardo ke hat jane aur darwazon ke khul jane se subh ke waqt ko jaan lenge. In darwazon ka khulna band hona bhi jannatiyon ke isharon aur hukmon par hoga. Yeh darwaze bhi is qadar saaf shafaf aaina-numa hain ki bahar ki cheezein andar se nazar aayein. Chunki duniya mein din raat ki aadat thi is liye jo waqt jab chahenge payenge. Chunki arab subh-o-sham hi khana khane ke aadi the is liye jannati rizq ka waqt bhi wohi bataya gaya hai warna jannati jo chahein jab chahein maujood payenge.

Chanacha ek gharib munkar hadith mein hai ke subh sham ka theka hai, rizq to beshumar har waqt maujood hai lekin Allah ke doston ke paas in auqat mein hoorain aayengi jin mein adna darje ki woh hongi jo sirf zafran se paida ki gayi hain. Yeh nematon wali jannatein unhein milengi jo zahir batin Allah ke farmanbardar the jo ghussa pee jane wale aur logon se darguzar karne wale the jin ki sifatein (Qad aflaha al-mu'minun) 23. Al-Mu'minun: 1 ke shuru mein bayan hui hain aur farmaya gaya hai ke yahi waris firdous-e-bareen hain jin ke liye dawami taur par Jannat-ul-Firdaus Allah ne likh di hai (Allah, ae Allah humein bhi tu apni rahmat-e-kamila se firdous-e-bareen mein pohcha, Ameen))

Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ki amad mein takheer kyun? Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne ek martaba Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) se farmaya aap jitna aate hain us se ziyada kyun nahi aate? Iske jawab par yeh aayat utri hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ke aane mein takheer hogayi jis se Huzoor (ﷺ) ghamgeen hue phir aap yeh aayat lekar nazil hue. Riwayat hai ke barah din ya is se kuch kam tak nahi aaye the jab aaye toh Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kaha itni takheer kyun hui? Mushrikeen toh kuch aur hi udane lage the is par yeh aayat utri. Pas go yeh aayat Surah Ad-Duha ki aayat jaisi hai. Kehte hain ke chaalis din tak mulaqat na hui thi jab mulaqat hui toh aap ne farmaya mera shouk toh bahut hi bechain kiye hue tha. Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya is se kisi qadr ziyada shouk khud mujhe aap ki mulaqat ka tha lekin main Allah ke hukm ka mamoor aur paband hoon wahan se jab bheja jaaun tab hi aa sakta hoon warna nahi usi waqt yeh wahi nazil hui. Lekin yeh riwayat ghareeb hai Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ne aane mein der lagai phir jab aaye toh Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ruk jaane ki wajah daryaft ki aap ne jawab diya ke jab log nakhun na katroayein, ungliyan aur poriyan saaf na rakhein, moonchein past na karayein, miswak na karein toh hum kaise aa sakte hain? Phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmai. Musnad Imam Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Umme Salama (R.A) se farmaya majlis durust aur theek thak kar lo aaj woh farishta aa raha hai jo aaj se pehle zameen par kabhi nahi aaya. Hamare aage peeche ki tamam cheezein usi Allah ki hain yaani duniya aur aakhirat aur iske darmiyan ki yaani dono nafkho ke darmiyan ki cheezein bhi usi ki tamleek ki hain. Aane wale amoor aakhirat aur guzar chuke hue amoor duniya aur duniya aakhirat ke darmiyan ke amoor sab usi ke qabze mein hain. Tera Rabb bhoolne wala nahi usne aap ko apni yaad se framosh nahi kiya. Na iski yeh sifat. Jaise farmaan (وَالضُّحٰى ۙ) (Ad-Duha: 1) Qasam hai chasht ke waqt ki aur raat ki jab woh dhanp le na toh tera Rabb tujh se dastbardaar hai na na-khush. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai aap farmate hain jo kuch Allah ne apni Kitab mein halal kar diya woh halal hai aur jo haram kar diya haram hai aur jis se khamosh raha woh aafiyat hai tum Allah ki aafiyat ko qubool karlo, Allah kisi cheez ka bhoolne wala nahi phir aap ne yehi jumla tilawat farmaya. Aasman-o-Zameen aur sari makhlooq ka khaliq malik mudabbir mutasarrif wahi hai. Koi nahi jo iske kisi hukm ko taal sake. Toh usi ki ibadatein kiye chala ja aur usi par jama reh iske maseel shabeeh ham-naam palla koi nahi. Woh babarkat hai woh bulandiyon wala hai iske naam mein tamam khoobiyan hain Jalla Jalaluhu.

Musnad Imam Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Umme Salama (R.A) se farmaya majlis durust aur theek thak kar lo aaj woh farishta aa raha hai jo aaj se pehle zameen par kabhi nahi aaya. Hamare aage peeche ki tamam cheezein usi Allah ki hain yaani duniya aur aakhirat aur iske darmiyan ki yaani dono nafkho ke darmiyan ki cheezein bhi usi ki tamleek ki hain. Aane wale amoor aakhirat aur guzar chuke hue amoor duniya aur duniya aakhirat ke darmiyan ke amoor sab usi ke qabze mein hain. Tera Rabb bhoolne wala nahi usne aap ko apni yaad se framosh nahi kiya. Na iski yeh sifat. Jaise farmaan (وَالضُّحٰى ۙ) (Ad-Duha: 1) Qasam hai chasht ke waqt ki aur raat ki jab woh dhanp le na toh tera Rabb tujh se dastbardaar hai na na-khush. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai aap farmate hain jo kuch Allah ne apni Kitab mein halal kar diya woh halal hai aur jo haram kar diya haram hai aur jis se khamosh raha woh aafiyat hai tum Allah ki aafiyat ko qubool karlo, Allah kisi cheez ka bhoolne wala nahi phir aap ne yehi jumla tilawat farmaya. Aasman-o-Zameen aur sari makhlooq ka khaliq malik mudabbir mutasarrif wahi hai. Koi nahi jo iske kisi hukm ko taal sake. Toh usi ki ibadatein kiye chala ja aur usi par jama reh iske maseel shabeeh ham-naam palla koi nahi. Woh babarkat hai woh bulandiyon wala hai iske naam mein tamam khoobiyan hain Jalla Jalaluhu.

Munkirin-e-Qiyamat ki soch. Ba'z munkirin-e-qiyamat Qiyamat ka aana apne nazdeek muhal samajhte the aur maut ke baad jeena unke khayal mein namumkin tha, woh qiyamat ka aur uske din ki doosri aur naye sire ki zindagi ka haal sun kar sakht taajjub karte the. Jaise Quran ka farman hai: (Wa in ta'jab fa 'ajabun qauluhum a iza kunna turaban a inna lafi khalqin jadeed) (Ar-Ra'd: 5). Yaani agar tujhe taajjub hai toh unka yeh qaul bhi taajjub se khali nahi ke kya hum jab mar kar mitti ho jayenge phir hum nayi paidaish mein paida kiye jayenge? Surah Yaseen mein farmaya: Kya insan use nahi dekhta ke hum ne use nutfe se paida kiya, phir hum se saaf saaf jhagda karne laga aur hum par hi baatein banane laga aur apni paidaish ko bhula kar kehne laga ke in haddiyon ko jo gul gayi hain kaun zinda kar dega? Tu jawab de ke unhe woh Khaliq-e-Haqiqi zinda karega jis ne unhe awwal baar paida kiya tha, woh har ek aur har tarah ki paidaish se poora ba-khabar hai. 

Yahan bhi kafiron ke usi aitraz ka zikr hai ke hum mar kar phir zinda ho kar kaise khade ho sakte hain? Jawaban farmaya ja raha hai ke kya ise yeh bhi maloom ke woh kuch na tha aur hum ne ise paida kar diya. Shuru paidaish ka qail aur doosri paidaish ka munkir? Jab kuch na tha tab toh Allah use kuch kar dene par qadir tha aur ab jab ke kuch na kuch zaroor ho gaya, kya Allah qadir nahi ke ise phir se paida kar karde? Pas ibtida-e-afrinish daleel hai dobara ki paidaish par. Jis ne ibtida ki hai wahi aada karega aur aada ba-nisbat ibtida ke hamesha aasan hua karta hai. 

Sahih Hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mujhe Ibn-e-Adam jhutla raha hai aur ise yeh bhi layak na tha, mujhe Ibn-e-Adam eza de raha hai aur ise yeh bhi layak nahi. Uska mujhe jhutlana toh yeh hai ke kehta hai jis tarah Allah ne meri ibtida ki aada na karega, halankih zahir hai ke ibtida ba-nisbat aada ke mushkil hoti hai. Aur uska mujhe eza dena yeh hai ke kehta hai meri aulad hai, halankih main Ahad hoon, Samad hoon, na mere ma-baap, na aulad, na meri jins ka koi aur. Mujhe apni hi qasam hai ke main in sab ko jama karunga aur jin jin shaitanon ki yeh log mere siva ibadat karte the unhe bhi main jama karunga, phir unhe Jahannam ke samne launga jahan ghutnon ke bal gire pade honge. Jaise farman hai: (Wa tara kulla ummatin jasiyah) (Al-Jasiyah: 28). Har ummat ko tu dekhega ke ghutnon ke bal giri hui hogi. 

Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke qiyam ki halat mein unka hashr hoga. Jab tamam awwal-o-akhir jama ho jayenge toh hum un mein se bade bade mujrimon aur sarkashon ko alag kar lenge aur unke rais-o-ameer aur badiyon o buraiyon ke phailane wale, unke peshwa, unhe shrk-o-kufr ki taleem dene wale, unhe Allah ke gunahon ki taraf mail karne wale alag kar liye jayenge.

Jaise farman hai: (Hatta iza iddaraku fiha jami'an qalat ukhruhum li-ula'hum rabbana ha'ula'i adalluna fa-atihimm azaban di'fan minan-nar, qala likullin di'fun wa lakin la ta'lamun) (Al-A'raf: 38), jab wahan sab jama ho jayenge toh pichle aglon ki babat kahenge ke A Allah! inhi logon ne hamein behka rakha tha toh unhein dugna azab kar, al-akhirah. Phir khabar ka khabar par atf daal kar farmata hai ke Allah khoob janta hai ke sab se zyada azabon ka aur da'imi azabon ka aur jahannam ki aag ka sazawaar kaun kaun hai? Jaise dusri aayat mein hai ke farmayega: (Likullin di'fun wa lakin la ta'lamun) (Al-A'raf: 38) har ek ke liye dohra azab hai lekin tum ilm se kore ho.

Jahannam mein dakhul ya wurud? Musnad Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ki ek qareeb hadith mein hai Abu Sumayyah farmate hain jis wurud ka is ayat mein zikr hai is bare mein ikhtilaf hua koi kehta tha momin is mein dakhil na honge, koi kehta tha dakhil to honge lekin phir ba-sabab apne taqwa ke nijat pa jayenge. Maine Hazrat Jabir R.A se mil kar is baat ko daryaft kiya to aap ne فرمایا ward to sab honge. Aur riwayat mein hai ki dakhil to sab honge har ek naik bhi aur har ek bad bhi lekin momino par woh aag thandi aur salamati ban jayegi jaise Ibrahim Khalilullah A.S par thi yahan tak ki is thandak ki shikayat khud aag karne lagegi phir un muttaqi logo ka wahan se chhutkara ho jayega. Khalid bin Ma'dan R.H farmate hain ki jab jannati jannat mein pahunch jayenge kahenge Allah ne to farmaya tha ki har ek jahannam par warid hone wala hai aur hamara wurud to hua hi nahi to un se farmaya jayega ki tum wahin se guzar kar to aa rahe ho lekin Allah Ta'ala ne us waqt aag ko thanda kar diya tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawahah R.A ek baar apni biwi sahibah ke ghutne par sar rakh kar lete hue the ki rone lage. Aap ki ahliya sahibah bhi rone lagin to aap ne un se daryaft farmaya ki tum kyun royin? Unhone jawab diya ki aap ko rota dekh kar. Aap ne farmaya mujhe to ayat (wa in minkum illa wariduha, kana 'ala rabbika hatman maqdiyya) (Surah (Maryam: 71) yaad aa gayi aur rona aa gaya. Mujhe kya maloom ki main nijat paunga nahi? Us waqt aap bimar the. Hazrat Abu Maysarah R.H jab raat ko apne bistar par sone ke liye jaate to rone lagte aur zaban se be-sakhta nikal jata ki kash ki main paida hi na hota. Ek martba aap se pucha gaya ki aakhir is rone dhone ki wajah kya hai? To farmaya yahi ayat hai. Ye to sabit hai ki wahan jana hoga aur ye nahi maloom ki nijat bhi hogi ya nahi? Ek buzurg shakhs ne apne bhai se farmaya ki aap ko ye to maloom hai ki hume jahannam par se guzar na hai? Unhone jawab diya haan yaqinan maloom hai. Phir pucha kya ye bhi jaante ho ki wahan se par ho jaoge? Unhone farmaya is ka koi ilm nahi phir farmaya hamare liye hansi khushi kaisi? Ye sun kar us waqt se lekar maut ki ghadi tak un ke honto par hansi nahi aayi. Nafi bin Azraq Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ka is bare mein ikhtilaf tha ki yahan wurud se murad dakhil hona hai to aap ne daleel mein ayat-e-Quran (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 98) pesh kar ke farmaya dekho yahan wurud se murad dakhil hona hai ya nahi? Phir aap ne dusri ayat tilawat farmayi (yaqdumu qawmahu yawmal qiyamati fa awradahumun nara wa bi'sal wirdul mawrud) (Surah (Hud: 98) aur farmaya batao Firaun apni kaum ko jahannam mein le jayega ya nahi? Pas ab ghaur karo ki hum is mein dakhil to zaroor honge ab niklenge bhi ya nahi?

Ghaliban tujhe toh Allah na nikale ga is liye ke tu is ka munkar hai yeh sun kar Nafi khisiyana ho kar hans diya. Yeh Nafi Khariji tha is ki kuniyat Abu Rashid thi. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ne isay samjhate hue ayat (Wa nasaqul-mujrimina ila jahannama wirdan 19. (Maryam: 86) bhi parhi thi. Aur yeh bhi farmaya tha ke pehle buzurg logon ki ek dua yeh bhi thi ke Allahumma akhrijni minan-nari salimin wa adkhilnil-jannata ghaniman, "Aiye Allah mujhe jahannam se sahi salim nikal le aur jannat mein hansi khushi pohncha de." Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein yeh bhi marwi hai ke is ke mukhatib kuffar hain. Ikrimah R.H farmate hain yeh zalim log hain isi tarah hum is ayat ko parhte thay. Yeh bhi Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke naik bad sab warid honge. Dekho Firaun aur us ki kaum ke liye aur gunahgaron ke liye bhi wurood ka lafz dukhool ke ma'ani mein khud Quran-e-Kareem ki do ayaton mein warid hai. Tirmidhi waghera mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain warid toh sab honge phir guzar apne apne aamal ke mutabiq hoga. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain ke pul sirat se sab ko guzarna hoga yahi aag ke paas khara hona hai ab baaz toh bijli ki tarah guzar jayenge, baaz hawa ki tarah, baaz parindon ki tarah, baaz tez raftar ghoron ki tarah, baaz tez raftar oonton ki tarah, baaz tez chaal wale paidal insan ki tarah yahan tak ke sab se aakhir jo Musalman is se paar hoga yeh woh hoga jis ke sirf pair ke anguthe par noor hoga girta parta nijat payega. Pul sirat phisalni cheez hai jis par babool jaise aur go-gharu jaise kante hain dono taraf farishton ki safein hongi jin ke hathon mein jahannam ke tikat honge jin se pakar pakar kar logon ko jahannam mein dhakel denge al-akh. Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain yeh talwar ki dhaar se zyada tez hoga. Pehla giroh toh bijli ki tarah aan ki aan mein paar hojayega, dusra giroh hawa ki tarah jayega, teesra tez raftar ghoron ki tarah, chautha tez raftar janwar ki tarah. Farishte har taraf se duaein kar rahe honge ke aye Allah salamat rakh Ilahi bacha le. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki bohat si marfoo ahadith mein bhi yeh mazmoon warid hua hai. Hazrat Ka'ab R.H ka bayan hai ke jahannam apni peeth par tamam logon ko jama legi. Jab sab naik-o-bad jama hojayenge toh hukum-e-bari hoga ke apne walon ko toh pakar le aur jannatiyon ko chor de. Ab jahannam sab bure logon ka nawala kar jayegi. Woh bure logon ko is tarah janti pehchanti hai jis tarah tum apni aulad ko balke is se bhi zyada. Momin saaf bach jayenge. Suno jahannam ke daroghaon ke qad ek sau saal ki raah ke hain un mein se har ek ke paas gurz hain ek marte hain toh saat lakh admiyon ka chora hojata hai. Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya mujhe apne Rab ki zaat-e-pak se ummeed hai ke Badr aur Hudaibiya ke jihad mein jo imandar shareek thay un mein se ek bhi dozakh mein na jayega yeh sun kar Hazrat Hafsa R.A ne kaha yeh kaise?

Quran toh kehta hai ki tum mein se har ek is par وارد (waarid) hone wala hai, toh Aapne iske baad ki doosri aayat padh di ki muttaqi log is se nijat pa jayenge aur zalim log usi mein reh jayenge. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ki jiske teen bachche فوت (faut) ho gaye hon use aag na chhuyegi magar sirf qasam poori hone ke taur par. Is se murad yahi aayat hai. Ibn Jarir mein hai ki ek sahabi R.A ko bukhar chadha hua tha jiski iyadat ke liye Rasool Maqbul ﷺ hamare sath tashrif le chale, Aapne farmaya ki Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal ka farman hai ki yeh bukhar bhi ek aag hai, main apne momin bando ko is mein is liye mubtala karta hoon ki yeh jahannam ki aag ka badla ho jaye. Yeh hadis gharib hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.H ne bhi yahi farmaya kar phir is aayat ki tilawat farmayi hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs Surah Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad das martaba padh le uske liye jannat mein ek mahal tameer hota hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ne kaha phir to hum bahut se mahal bana lenge, Aapne jawab diya Allah ke paas koi kami nahi, woh behtar se behtar aur bahut se bahut dene wala hai. Aur jo shakhs Allah ki rah mein ek hazaar aayatein padh le Allah Ta'ala qiyamat ke din use nabiyon, siddiqon, shahidon aur salihon mein likh le lega. Fi al-waqi' unka sath behtareen sathiyon ka sath hai. Aur jo shakhs kisi tankhwah ki wajah se nahi balki Allah ki khushi ke liye musalman lashkaron ki, unki pusht ki taraf se hifazat karne ke liye pehra de, woh apni aankh se bhi jahannam ki aag ko na dekhega magar sirf qasam poori karne ke liye, kyunke Allah ka farman hai tum mein se har ek is par وارد (waarid) hone wala hai. Allah ki rah mein kharch karne se bhi saat sau guna ziyada ajr rakhta hai aur riwayat mein hai saat hazaar guna. Abu Dawud mein hai ki namaz, roza aur zikrullah, Allah ki rah ke kharch par saat sau guna darja rakhte hain. Qatadah R.H farmate hain murad is aayat se guzarna hai. Abdul Rahman kehte hain musalman toh pul-e-sirat se guzar jayenge aur mushrik jahannam mein jayenge. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya us din bahut se mard aur aurat is par se phisal jayenge. Pul-e-sirat par jaane ke baad parahizgar toh paar ho jayenge, haan kafir gunahgar apne apne amaal ke mutabiq nijat payenge. Jaise amal honge utni der wahan lag jayegi. Phir nijat yafta apne doosre musalman bhaiyon ki sifarish karenge. Malaika shafahat karenge aur anbiya bhi. Phir bahut se log toh jahannam mein se is halat mein se nikalenge ki aag unhe kha chuki hogi magar chehre ki sajda ki jagah bachi hui hogi. Phir apne apne baaki iman ke hisab se dozakh se nikale jayenge. Jinke dilon mein baqdar dinar ke iman hoga woh awwal nikalenge, phir is se kam wale, yahan tak ki rai ke dane ke barabar iman wale, phir is se kam wale, phir is se bhi kami wale, phir woh jisne apni poori umr mein la ilaha illallah keh diya ho go kuch bhi neki na ki ho, phir toh jahannam mein wahi reh jayenge jin par hamesha aur dawam likha ja chuka hai.

Yeh tamam khulasah hai un ahadith ka jo sihat ke sath achuki hain. Pas pul-e-sirat par jane ke baad naik log paar hojayenge aur bad log kat kat kar jahannam mein girpadenge.))))

Kasrat-e-Maal Fareeb-e-Zindagi. Allah ki saaf sareeh aayton se, Parwardigar ke daleel-o-burhan wale kalam se kuffar ko koi faida nahi pahunchta, woh un se munh mod lete hain, dide pher lete hain aur apni zahiri shaan-o-shaukat se unhe mar'oub karna chahte hain. Kehte hain batao kis ke makanat pur-takalluf hain aur kis ki baithkein saji hui aur baronaq hain? Pas hum jo ke maal-o-daulat, shaan-o-shaukat, izzat-o-abru mein un se badhe hue hain, hum Allah ke pyare hain ya yeh jo ke chupe phirte hain? Khane pine ko nahi pate, kahin Arqam bin Abul Arqam ke ghar chupte hain, kahin aur, idhar udhar bhagte phirte hain. Jaise aur aayat mein hai kafiron ne kaha (Lau kana khairam ma sabaquna ilaihi wa iz lam yahtadu bihi fasayaquluna haza ifkun qadeem 11) (Al-Ahqaf: 11) Agar yeh deen behtar hota toh ise pehle hum mante ya yeh? Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ki kaum ne bhi yahi kaha tha ke (Anu'minu laka wattaba'aka illal arzaluuna) tere manne wale toh sab ghareeb mohtaj log hain hum tere tabe'dar ban nahi sakte. Aur aayat mein hai ke isi tarah unhe dhoka lag raha hai aur keh uthte hain ke kya yahi woh Allah ke pyare bande hain jinhe Allah ne hum par fazilat di hai? Phir un ke is mughalte ka jawab diya ke un se pehle un se bhi zahir-dari mein badhe hue aur maal-dari mein aage nikle hue log the lekin un ki bad-aamaliyon ki wajah se hum ne unhe teh-s-nehs kar diya. Un ke majalis, un ke makanat, un ki quwatein, un ki maal-dariyaan un se siwa theen. Shaan-o-shaukat mein, teep-tap mein, takallufaat mein, imarat mein aur sharafat mein un se kahin zyada theen. Un ke takabbur aur anad ki wajah se hum ne un ka bhas uda diya. Gharat aur barbad kar diya. Faruniyon ko dekh lo un ke baghat, un ki nahreen, un ki khetiyan, un ki shandar makanat aur aalishan mehlat ab tak maujud hain aur woh gharat kar diye gaye, machhliyon ka luqma ban gaye. Maqam se murad maskin aur nematein hain, "Nadi" se murad majalis aur baithkein hain. Arab mein baithkon aur logon ke jama hone ki jagahon ko nadi aur nadiya kehte hain jaise aayat (Fi naadikumul munkara fama kana jawaba qaumihi illa an qalu/itna bi'azabin Allahi in kunta minas sadiqin 29) (Al-Ankabut: 29) mein hai yahi un mushrikeen ka qaul tha ke hum bi-itibar-e-dunya tum se bahut badhe hue hain, libas mein, maal mein, mata' mein, surat shakal mein hum tum se afzal hain.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai kafiron ne kaha (Lau kana khairam ma sabaquna ilaihi wa iz lam yahtadu bihi fasayaquluna haza ifkun qadeem 11) (Al-Ahqaf: 11) Agar yeh deen behtar hota toh ise pehle hum mante ya yeh? Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ki kaum ne bhi yahi kaha tha ke (Anu'minu laka wattaba'aka illal arzaluuna) tere manne wale toh sab ghareeb mohtaj log hain hum tere tabe'dar ban nahi sakte. Aur aayat mein hai ke isi tarah unhe dhoka lag raha hai aur keh uthte hain ke kya yahi woh Allah ke pyare bande hain jinhe Allah ne hum par fazilat di hai? Phir un ke is mughalte ka jawab diya ke un se pehle un se bhi zahir-dari mein badhe hue aur maal-dari mein aage nikle hue log the lekin un ki bad-aamaliyon ki wajah se hum ne unhe teh-s-nehs kar diya. Un ke majalis, un ke makanat, un ki quwatein, un ki maal-dariyaan un se siwa theen. Shaan-o-shaukat mein, teep-tap mein, takallufaat mein, imarat mein aur sharafat mein un se kahin zyada theen. Un ke takabbur aur anad ki wajah se hum ne un ka bhas uda diya. Gharat aur barbad kar diya. Faruniyon ko dekh lo un ke baghat, un ki nahreen, un ki khetiyan, un ki shandar makanat aur aalishan mehlat ab tak maujud hain aur woh gharat kar diye gaye, machhliyon ka luqma ban gaye. Maqam se murad maskin aur nematein hain, "Nadi" se murad majalis aur baithkein hain. Arab mein baithkon aur logon ke jama hone ki jagahon ko nadi aur nadiya kehte hain jaise aayat (Fi naadikumul munkara fama kana jawaba qaumihi illa an qalu/itna bi'azabin Allahi in kunta minas sadiqin 29) (Al-Ankabut: 29) mein hai yahi un mushrikeen ka qaul tha ke hum bi-itibar-e-dunya tum se bahut badhe hue hain, libas mein, maal mein, mata' mein, surat shakal mein hum tum se afzal hain.

Mushrikon se Mubahala. In kafiron ko jo tumhein ناحق par aur apne aap ko haq par samajh rahe hain aur apni khush-hali aur farigh-bali par itminan kiye baithe hue hain un se keh dijiye ke gumrahon ki rassi daraz hoti hai unhein Allah ki taraf se dheel di jati hai jab tak ke Qiyamat na ajaye ya un ki maut na ajaye. Us waqt unhein poora pata chal jayega ke fi-waqi' bura shakhs kaun tha aur kis ke sathi kamzor thay duniya to dhalti charhti chaon hai na khud is ka aitbaar na is ke saman-o-asbab ka. Yeh to apni sarkashi mein barhte hi rahenge. Goya is aayat mein mushrikon se mubahala hai jaise yahood se Surah Jumah mein mubahala ki aayat hai ke aao hamare muqable mein maut ki tamanna karo. Isi tarah Surah Ale-Imran mein mubahale ka zikr hai ke jab tum apne khilaf dalelein sun kar bhi Isa (Alaihis Salam) ke ibn-ullah hone ke mudda'i ho to aao bal-bachon samet maidan mein jaakar jhoote par Allah ki laanat parne ki dua karein. Pas na to mushrikeen muqable par aaye na yahood ki himmat parti na nasrani mard-e-maidan bane.

Gumraahon ki gumraahi mein taraqqi. Jis tarah gumraahon ki gumraahi barhti rehti hai usi tarah hidayat walon ki hidayat barhti rehti hai jaise farman hai ki koi surat utarti hai toh ba'az log kehne lagte hain tum mein se kis ko is ne iman mein zyada kar diya ? Al-kh, Baqiyat-e-Salihat ki poori tafsir un hi lafzon ki tashreeh mein Surah Kahf mein guzar chuki hai. Yahan farmata hai ki yehi payedar nekiyan jaza aur sawab ke lihaz se aur anjam aur badle ke lihaz se nekong ke liye behtar hain. 

Abdul Razzaq mein hai ki ek din Huzoor ﷺ ek khushk darakht tale baithe hue the us ki shakh pakar kar hilayi toh sookhe patte jharne lage Aap ne farmaya dekho isi tarah insan ke gunah La ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar Subhanallah walhamdulillah kehne se jharte hain. Aye Abu Darda in ka wird rakh is se pehle ki woh waqt aaye ki tu unhein na keh sake yehi Baqiyat-e-Salihat hain yehi jannat ke khazane hain is ko sun kar Hazrat Abu Darda ka yeh hal tha ki is hadis ko bayan farma kar farmate ki Wallah mein toh in kalmaat ko parhta hi rahoon ga kabhi in se zaban na rokunga go log mujhe majnoon kehne lagein. 

Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh hadis doosri sanad se hai.

Ayyar maqruz aur Hazrat Khabbab. Hazrat Khabbab bin Arat R.A farmate hain main lohar tha aur mera kuch qarz Aas bin Wail ke zimme tha main us se taqaza karne ko gaya toh us ne kaha main toh tera qarz us waqt tak ada na karunga jab tak ke tu Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ki tabedari se na nikal jaye main ne kaha main toh yeh kufr us waqt tak bhi nahi kar sakta ke tu mar kar dobara zinda ho. Us kafir ne kaha bas toh phir yehi sahi jab main marne ke bad zinda hunga toh zaroor mujhe mera maal aur meri aulaad bhi milegi wahin tera qarz bhi ada kar dunga toh aa jana. Is par yeh aayat utri. (Bukhari Muslim) Dusri riwayat mein hai ke main ne Makkah mein us ki talwar banayi thi us ki ujrat meri udhaar thi. Farmata hai ke kya use ghaib ki khabar mil gayi? ya us ne Allah Rehman se koi qol-o-qarar le liya? aur riwayat mein hai ke is par mere bohat se darham ba-toor qarz ke charh gaye is liye mujhe jo jawab diya main ne uska tazkira Rasool Allah ﷺ se kiya is par yeh aayatein utrin aur riwayat mein hai ke kai ek musalmanon ka qarz us ke zimme tha un ke taqazon par us ne kaha ke kya tumhare deen mein yeh nahi ke jannat mein sona chandi resham phal phool waghera honge? Hum ne kaha han hai toh kaha bas toh yeh cheezein mujhe zaroor milengi main wahin tum sab ko de dunga. Pas yeh aayatein fardan tak utrin. Walda ki dusri qiraat waw ke pesh se bhi hai maana dono ke ek hi hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke zabar se toh mufrad ke maane mein hai aur pesh se jama ke maane mein hai. Qais qabeele ki yehi lughat hai Wallahu A'lam. Is maghroor ko jawab milta hai ke kya use ghaib par itlaa hai? Use aakhirat ke apne anjaam ki khabar hai? Jo yeh qasmein kha kar keh raha hai? Ya us ne Allah se koi qol-o-qarar, ahd-o-paiman liya hai ya us ne Allah ki tauheed maan li hai ke us ki wajah se use dakhool-e-jannat ka yaqeen ho? Chunancha aayat (La yamlikoonash-shaf'aata illa man-ittakhaza 'indal-Rahmani 'ahda) (Surah (Maryam: 87) mein Allah ki wahdaniyat ke kalme ka qayil ho jana hi murad liya gaya hai. Phir us ke kalam ki تاکید ke sath nafi ki jati hai. Aur us ke khilaf moukkad bayan ho raha hai ke is ka yeh ghuroor ka kalma bhi hamare haan likha ja chuka hai is ka kufr bhi milna toh kuja us ke bar-aks duniya ka maal-o-mata' aur aulaad-o-kunba bhi is se chheen liya jayega aur woh tan-tanha hamare huzoor mein paish hoga Ibn Masood R.A ki qiraat mein (Wa narithuhu ma 'indah) hai. Is ki jama-jatha aur is ke aamal hamare qabze mein hain. Yeh toh khali hath sab kuch chor-chhaar hamare samne paish hoga.)

Allah Ta'ala ke siwa ma'bud. Kafiron ka khayal hai ke un ke Allah ke siwa aur ma'bud un ke hami madadgar honge. Ghalat khayal hai balki muhal hai balki mamla is ke bar-aks aur bilkul bar-aks hai un ki poori mohtaji ke din yaani Qiyamat mein yeh saf munkar ho jayenge aur apne abidon ke dushman ban kar khade honge. Jaise farmaya un se badh kar bad-rah aur gum-karda-rah kaun hai jo Allah ko chhod kar unhe pukar raha hai jo Qiyamat tak jawab na de saken un ki dua se bilkul ghafil hon aur roz-e-mahshar un ke dushman ban jayen aur un ki ibadat ka bilkul inkar kar jayen. 'Kalla' ki doosri qira'at 'Kul' bhi hai khud yeh kuffar bhi us din Allah ke siwa auron ki pooja-pat ka inkar kar jayenge. Yeh sab abid-o-ma'bud jehannami honge, ek doosre ke sathi honge. Woh us par yeh us par la'nat-o-phatkar karega, har ek doosre par daalega, ek doosre ko bura kahega, sakht tar jhagde padenge, sare talluqat kat jayenge, ek doosre ke dushman ho jayenge. Madad to kahan maruwat tak na hogi. Ma'bud abidon ke liye aur abid ma'budon ke liye balaye-be-darman hasrat-e-be-payan ho jayenge. Kya tujhe nahi maloom ke in kafiron ko har waqt shayatein na-farmaniyon par amada karte rehte, Musalmanon ke khilaf uksate rehte hain, arzoo mein badhate hain, tughyan aur sarkashi mein aage karte rehte hain jaise farman hai ke zikr-e-Rahman se munh modne wale shaitan ke hawale ho jaate hain. Tu jaldi na kar un ke liye koi bad-dua na kar hum ne khud amdan unhe dheel de rakhi hai unhe badhta rehne de aakhir waqt-e-muqarrara par daboch liye jayenge. Allah Ta'ala in zalimon ke kartooton se be-khabar nahi hai unhe to kuch yunhi si dheel hai jis mein hi apne gunahon mein badhe chale ja rahe hain aakhir sakht azabon ki taraf be-basi ke sath ja padenge tum faida hasil karlo lekin yaad rakho ke tumhara asli thikana dozakh hi hai. Hum un ke saal ke mahine din aur waqt shumar kar rahe hain un ke saans bhi hamare gine hue hain muqarrara waqt poora hote hi azabon mein phans jayenge.

Hum un ke saal ke mahine din aur waqt shumar kar rahe hain un ke saans bhi hamare gine hue hain muqarrara waqt poora hote hi azabon mein phans jayenge.

Allah Ta'ala ke siwa ma'bud. Kafiron ka khayal hai ke un ke Allah ke siwa aur ma'bud un ke hami madadgar honge. Ghalat khayal hai balki muhal hai balki mamla is ke bar-aks aur bilkul bar-aks hai un ki poori mohtaji ke din yaani Qiyamat mein yeh saf munkar ho jayenge aur apne abidon ke dushman ban kar khade honge. Jaise farmaya un se badh kar bad-rah aur gum-karda-rah kaun hai jo Allah ko chhod kar unhe pukar raha hai jo Qiyamat tak jawab na de saken un ki dua se bilkul ghafil hon aur roz-e-mahshar un ke dushman ban jayen aur un ki ibadat ka bilkul inkar kar jayen. 'Kalla' ki doosri qira'at 'Kul' bhi hai khud yeh kuffar bhi us din Allah ke siwa auron ki pooja-pat ka inkar kar jayenge. Yeh sab abid-o-ma'bud jehannami honge, ek doosre ke sathi honge. Woh us par yeh us par la'nat-o-phatkar karega, har ek doosre par daalega, ek doosre ko bura kahega, sakht tar jhagde padenge, sare talluqat kat jayenge, ek doosre ke dushman ho jayenge. Madad to kahan maruwat tak na hogi. Ma'bud abidon ke liye aur abid ma'budon ke liye balaye-be-darman hasrat-e-be-payan ho jayenge. Kya tujhe nahi maloom ke in kafiron ko har waqt shayatein na-farmaniyon par amada karte rehte, Musalmanon ke khilaf uksate rehte hain, arzoo mein badhate hain, tughyan aur sarkashi mein aage karte rehte hain jaise farman hai ke zikr-e-Rahman se munh modne wale shaitan ke hawale ho jaate hain.
