Allah Ta'ala ke mo'azzam mehmaan. Jo log Allah ki baaton par iman laaye, paighambaron ki tasdeeq ki, Allah ki farmanbardari ki, gunahon se bache rahe, Parwardigar ka dar dil mein rakha woh Allah ke haan ba-tor mo'azzam mehmanon ke jama honge noorani sandniyon ki sawari par aayenge aur khudai mehman khane mein ba-izzat dakhil kiye jayenge. Un ke barkhilaf Allah se khouf na khane wale, gunahgaar, rasulon ke dushman, dhakke kha kha kar oundhe munh ghaseete hue pyaas ke maare zaban nikale hue jabran qahran jahannam ke paas jama kiye jayenge. Ab batlao ki kaun martabe wala aur kaun achhe sathiyon wala hai? Momin apni qabr se munh utha kar dekhega ki us ke samne ek haseen khoobsoorat shakhs pakeeza poshakh pehne khushbu se mehakta chamakta damakta chehra liye khada hai puchega tum kaun ho? Woh kahega aap ne pehchana nahi main to aap ke naik aamal ka mujassam hoon aap ke amal noorani haseen aur mehakte hue the aaiye ab aap ko main apne kandhon par chadhakar ba-izzat-o-ikram mahshar mein le chalun ga kyunki duniya ki zindagi mein main aap par sawar raha hoon. Pas momin Allah ke paas sawari par sawar jayega. Un ki sawari ke liye noorani oont bhi muhayya honge. Yeh sab hansi khushi abru izzat ke sath jannat mein jayenge. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain wafd ka yeh dastoor hi nahi ki woh paidal aaye. Yeh muttaqi hazrat aisi noorani oontniyon par sawar honge ki makhlooq ki nigahon mein un se behtar koi sawari kabhi nahi aayi. Un ke palan sone ke honge. Yeh jannat ke darwazon tak in hi sawariyon par jayenge. In ki nakelein zabardad ki hongi. Ek marfoo riwayat mein hai lekin hadis bahut hi ghareeb hai Ibn Abi Hatim ki riwayat hai Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ek din hum Rasulullah (ﷺ) ke paas baithe hue the main ne is ayat ki tilawat ki aur kaha Ya Rasulullah (ﷺ) wafd to sawari par sawar aaya karta hai aap ne farmaya qasam us Allah ki jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ki yeh parsa log qabron se uthaye jayenge aur usi waqt safed rang noorani par-dar oontniyan apni sawari ke liye mojood payenge jin par sone ke palan honge jin ke pairon se noor buland ho raha hoga jo ek ek qadam itni door rakhein ge jahan tak nigah kaam kare yeh in par sawar ho kar ek jannati darakht ke paas pahuncheinge jahan se do nahrein jaari dekhein ge ek ka paani piyenge jis ke un ke dilon ke mail door ho jayenge doosri mein ghusal kareinge jis ke un ke jism noorani ho jayenge aur baal jam jayenge is ke baad na kabhi un ke baal uljhein na jism maile hon un ke chehre chamak uthein ge aur yeh jannat ke darwaze par pahuncheinge.

Surkh yaqut ka halqa sone ke darwaze par hoga jise yeh khatkhatayen ge nihayat sarili awaz us se niklegi aur hooron ko maloom hojaye ga ke un ke khawand aagaye, khazin-e-jannat aayenge aur darwaze kholenge. Jannati un ke noorani jismon aur shagufta chehron ko dekh kar sajde mein gir parna chahenge lekin woh foran keh uthega ke main to aap ka tabi hoon aap ka hukm-bardar hoon, ab un ke sath yeh chalenge. Un ki hooren tab na la saken gi aur khemon se nikal kar un se chimt jayengi aur kahengi ke aap hamare sartaj hain hamare mehboob hain, main hamesha aap ki wali hoon jo maut se door hoon, main nematon wali hoon ke kabhi meri nematen khatam na hongi, main khush rehne wali hoon ke kabhi na roothungi, main yahin rehne wali hoon ke kabhi aap se door na houngi. 

Yeh andar dakhil honge dekhenge ke sau sau gaz buland bala-khane hain, loolo aur motiyon par zard, surkh, sabz rang ki deewarein sone ki hain. Har deewar aik doosre ki ham-shakal hai, har makan mein sattar takht hain, har takht par sattar hooren hain, har hoor par sattar jode hain taham un ki kamar jhalak rahi hai. Un ke jama' ki miqdar duniya ki poori aik raat ke barabar hogi. 

Saf shafaf pani ki, khalis doodh ki jo janwaron ke than se nahi nikla, behtareen khush-zaiqa be-zarrar sharab-e-tahoor ki jise kisi insan ne nahi nichoda, umdah khalis shahad ke jo makkhiyon ke pait se nahi nikla, nahrein beh rahi hongi. Phaldar darakht mewon se lade hue jhoom rahe honge, chahe khare khare mewa tod lein chahe baithe baithe chahe lete lete. Sabz-o-safaid parind ud rahe hain jiske gosht khane ko ji chaha woh khud-ba-khud hazir hogaya jahan ka gosht khana chaha kha liya aur phir woh qudrat-e-Ilahi se zinda chala gaya. 

Charon taraf se farishte aa rahe hain aur salam keh rahe hain aur basharten suna rahe hain ke tum par salamati ho, yeh hi woh jannat hai jis ki tum khushkhabariyan diye jate rahe aur aaj is ke malik bana diye gaye. Woh yeh hai badla hai tumhare naik aamal ka jo tum duniya mein karte rahe. 

Un ki hooron mein se agar kisi ka aik baal bhi zameen par zahir kar diya jaye to sooraj ki roshni maand pad jaye. Yeh hadith to marfoo' bayan hui hai lekin taajjub nahi ke yeh mauqoof hi ho jaise ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke apne qaul se bhi marwi hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Koi un ke shafa'at karne wala un ke haq mein aik bhala lafz nikalne wala na hoga, momin to aik doosron ki shafa'at karenge lekin yeh bad-naseeb is se mehroom hain, yeh khud kahenge ke: 
(Fama lana min shafi'in) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 100)
Hamara koi sifarshi nahi na sacha dost hai. Haan jinho ne Allah se ahad le liya hai, yeh istisna munqati' hai.

Murad is ahd se Allah ki tauheed ki gawahi aur us par istiqamat hai yani sirf Allah ki ibadat, dusron ki puja se bezari aur la-taaluqi, sirf usi se madad ki umeed, tamam aarzuon ke pura hone ki usi se aas. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A farmate hain in muwahideen ne Allah ka wada hasil kar liya hai. Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala farmayega ke jis se mera ahd hai woh khada ho jaye. Logon ne kaha Hazrat hamein bhi woh bata dijiye aap ne farmaya yun kaho (Allahumma fatir-as-samawati wal-ard, alim-il-ghaibi wash-shahadati, fa inni a'hadu ilaika fi hazhil-hayat-id-dunya annaka in takilni ila 'amalin yuqarribuni min-ash-sharri wa yuba'aduni min-al-khairi, wa inni la asiqu illa bi rahmatika, faj'al li 'indaka 'ahdan tuwadihi li yaumal-qiyamati, innaka la tukhlif-ul-mi'aad) aur riwayat mein is ke sath yeh bhi hai: khaifam-mustajiram-mustaghfiran rahibam-raghaban ilaika (Ibn Abi Hatim).)

Isa Alaihis Salam ka taaruf is mubarak surat ke shuru mein is baat ka sabut guzar chuka ke Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam Allah ke bande hain. Unhein Allah Ta'ala ne baap ke baghair apne hukm se Hazrat Maryam Siddiqa ke batn se paida kiya hai. Is liye yahan un logon ki nadani bayan ho rahi hai jo Aap ko Allah ka beta qarar dete hain. Jis se Zaat-e-Ilahi pak hai. Unke qaul ko bayan farmaya. Phir farmaya yeh bari bhari baat hai ada aur ada teenon lughat hain lekin mashhoor ada hai. Unki yeh baat itni buri hai ke asman kapkapa kar toot parre aur zameen jhatke le le kar phat jaye. Is liye ke zameen-o-asman Allah Ta'ala ki izzat-o-azmat jante hain, un mein Rab ki tauheed samai hui hai unhein maloom hai ke in badkar besamjh insanon ne Allah ki zaat par tuhmat bandhi hai na is ki jins ka koi na is ki maan na aulad na is ke shareek na is jaisa koi. Tamam makhlooq is ki wahdaniyat ki shahid hai kainat ka ek ek zarra is ki tauheed par dalalat karne wala hai. Allah ke sath shirk karne walon ke shirk se sari makhlooq kaanp uthti hai. Qareeb hota hai ke nizam-e-kainat darham barham ho jaye. Shirk ke sath koi neki kar-amad nahi hoti. Kya ajab ke is ke bar-aks tauheed ke sath ke gunah kul ke kul Allah Ta'ala maaf farma de. Jaise ke hadith mein hai apne marne walon ko La ilaha illallah ki talqin karo. Maut ke waqt jis ne ise keh liya uske liye jannat wajib ho gayi. Sahaba R.A ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ jis ne zindagi mein keh liya? Farmaya uske liye aur zyada wajib ho gayi. Qasam Allah ki jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai ke zameen-o-asman aur un ki aur un ke darmiyan ki aur un ke neeche ki tamam cheezein tarazu ke ek palre mein rakh di jayen aur La ilaha illallah ki shahadat dusre palre mein rakhi jaye to woh un sab se wazan mein barrh jaye isi ki mazeed daleel woh hadith hai jis mein tauheed ke ek chote se parche ka gunahon ke bare bare daftaron se wazni ho jana aaya hai Wallahu A'lam. Pas un ka yeh maqoola itna bad hai jise sun kar asman bujho Allah ki azmat ke kaanp uthe aur zameen bujho ghazab ke phat jaye aur pahar pash pash ho jayen. Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain ek pahar dusre pahar se daryaft karta hai ke kya aaj koi aisa shakhs bhi tujh par charrha jis ne Allah ka zikr kiya ho? Woh khushi se jawab deta hai ke haan. Pas pahar bhi batil aur jhoot baat ko aur bhli baat ko sunte hain aur kalam nahi karte. Phir Aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. Marwi hai ke Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne jab zameen ko aur iske darakhton ko paida kiya toh har darakht Ibn-e-Adam ko phal phool aur nafa deta tha magar jab zameen par rehne wale logon ne Allah ke liye aulad ka lafz bola toh zameen hil gayi aur darakhton mein kante parr gaye. Kaab kehte hain malaika ghazabnak ho gaye aur jahannam zor shor se bharak uthi. Musnad Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool ﷺ hai ke logon ki eza-dihanda baaton par Allah se zyada sabir koi nahi.

Log us ke sath shareek karte hain, us ki auladein muqarrar karte hain aur woh unhein aafiyat de raha hai, roziyan pohncha raha hai, buraiyan un se talta rehta hai. Pas un ki is baat se ke Allah ki aulad hai zameen-o-asmaan aur pahaad tak tang hain, Allah ki azmat-o-shaan ke laiq nahi ke us ke haan aulad ho. Us ke larke larkiyan hon is liye ke tamam makhlooq us ki ghulami mein hai, us ki jor ka ya us jaisa koi aur nahi zameen-o-asmaan mein jo hain sab us ke zer-e-farman aur hazir bash ghulam hain, woh sab ka aaqa, sab ka paalanhaar, sab ka khabar lene wala hai. Sab ki ginti us ke paas hai, sab ko us ke ilm ne gher rakha hai, sab us ki qudrat ke ahate mein hain. Har mard-o-aurat, chhote bare ki use ittila hai, shuru paidaish se khatam duniya tak ka use ilm hai, us ka koi madadgar nahi na us ka shareek-o-saji. Har ek beyaro madadgar us ke samne Roz-e-Qayamat pesh hone wala hai, sari mroop ke faisle us ke haath mein hain. Wahi Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu sab ke hisab kitab chukayega, jo chahega karega, aadil hai zalim nahi, kisi ki haq talfi us ki shaan se baeed hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ki jo banda apne Maula ki marzi ka talib ho jata hai aur us ki khushi ke kamon mein mashghool ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal Jibril (Alaihis Salam) se farmata hai ki mera flan banda mujhe khush karna chahta hai suno main us se khush ho gaya main ne apni rahmatein us par nazil karni shuru kar di hain. Pas Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) nida karte hain ki flan par rahmat-e-Ilahi ho gayi phir hamilan-e-Arsh bhi yehi munadi karte hain phir un ke pas wale gharz saton aasmanon mein yeh aawaz goonj jati hai phir zameen par us ki maqbuliyat utarti hai. Yeh hadith gharib hai aisi hi ek aur hadith bhi Musnad Ahmad mein gharabat wali hai jis mein yeh bhi hai ki mohabbat aur shohrat kisi ki burai ya bhalai ke sath aasmanon se Allah ki janib se utarti hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein isi qism ki hadith ke baad An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka is ayat-e-qurani ko padhna bhi marwi hai. Momin un se mohabbat karne lagte hain un ka zikr-e-khair hota hai aur un ki maut ke baad bhi un ki behtareen shohrat baqi rehti hai. 

Muzarram bin Habban kehte hain ki jo banda sache aur mukhlis dil se Allah ki taraf jhukta hai Allah Ta'ala mominon ke dilon ko us ki taraf jhuka deta hai woh us se mohabbat aur pyar karne lagte hain. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka farman hai banda jo bhalai burai karta hai Allah Ta'ala use isi ki chadar odha deta hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ki ek shakhs ne irada kiya ki main Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat is tarah se karunga ki tamam logon mein meri neki ki shohrat ho jaye ab woh ibadat-e-Ilahi ki taraf jhuk pada jab dekho namaz mein.

Masjid mein sab se awal aaye aur sab ke baad jaye isi tarah saat mah use guzar gaye lekin us ne jab bhi suna yahi suna ki log use riya-kar kehte hain us ne yeh halat dekh kar ab apne ji mein ahad kar liya ki main sirf Allah ki khushnudi ke liye amal karunga kisi amal mein to na badha lekin khulus ke sath aamal shuru kar diye natija yeh hua ki thode hi dinon mein har shakhs ki zuban se nikalne laga ki Allah Ta'ala fulaan shakhs par raham farmaye ab to woh waqayi Allah wala ban gaya hai phir aap ne usi ayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ki yeh ayat Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf R.A ki hijrat ke bare mein nazil hui hai lekin yeh قول durust nahi is liye ki yeh puri surat Makkah mein nazil hui hai hijrat ke baad is surat ki kisi ayat ka nazil hona sabit nahi. Aur jo asar Imam sahib ne warid kiya hai woh sanad an bhi sahi nahi wallahu alam. Hum ne Quran ko Aey Nabi teri zuban mein yani arabi zuban mein bilkul asan kar ke nazil farmaya hai jo fasahat-o-balaghat wali behtareen zuban hai taaki tu unhein jo Allah ka khauf rakhte hain, dilon mein iman aur zahir mein nek aamal rakhte hain, Allah ki bashartein sunade aur jo haq se hate hue batil par mite hue istiqamat se door khudi mein mamoor jhagdalu jhoote andhe behre fasik fajir zalim gunahgar bad-kirar hain unhein Allah ki pakad se aur us ke azab se mutanabbeh kar de jaise Quraish ke kuffar waghera. Bahut si ummaton ko jinhon ne Allah ke sath kufr kiya tha nabiyon ka inkar kiya tha hum ne halak kar diya. Jin mein se ek bhi baki nahi bacha ek ki awaz bhi duniya mein nahi rahi rukz ke lafzi ma'ani halki aur dhemi awaz ke hain.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ki yeh ayat Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf R.A ki hijrat ke bare mein nazil hui hai lekin yeh قول durust nahi is liye ki yeh puri surat Makkah mein nazil hui hai hijrat ke baad is surat ki kisi ayat ka nazil hona sabit nahi. Aur jo asar Imam sahib ne warid kiya hai woh sanad an bhi sahi nahi wallahu alam. Hum ne Quran ko Aey Nabi teri zuban mein yani arabi zuban mein bilkul asan kar ke nazil farmaya hai jo fasahat-o-balaghat wali behtareen zuban hai taaki tu unhein jo Allah ka khauf rakhte hain, dilon mein iman aur zahir mein nek aamal rakhte hain, Allah ki bashartein sunade aur jo haq se hate hue batil par mite hue istiqamat se door khudi mein mamoor jhagdalu jhoote andhe behre fasik fajir zalim gunahgar bad-kirar hain unhein Allah ki pakad se aur us ke azab se mutanabbeh kar de jaise Quraish ke kuffar waghera. Bahut si ummaton ko jinhon ne Allah ke sath kufr kiya tha nabiyon ka inkar kiya tha hum ne halak kar diya. Jin mein se ek bhi baki nahi bacha ek ki awaz bhi duniya mein nahi rahi rukz ke lafzi ma'ani halki aur dhemi awaz ke hain.

Allah Ta'ala ka ameen farishta. Farman hai ki jin ke dilon mein tauhid rachi hui hai aur jin ke aamal mein sunnat ka noor hai zaroori baat hai ki hum apne bandon ke dilon mein un ki mohabbat paida kar denge. Chunacha Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ki jab Allah Ta'ala kisi bande se mohabbat karne lagta hai toh Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) ko bula kar farmata hai ki main flan se mohabbat rakhta hoon tu bhi flan insaan se mohabbat rakh. Allah ka yeh ameen farishta bhi us se mohabbat karne lagta hai phir aasmanon ke farishte us se mohabbat karne lagte hain phir us ki maqbuliyat zameen par utari jati hai aur jab kisi bande se Allah Ta'ala naraz ho jata hai toh Jibril (Alaihis Salam) se farmata hai ki us se main na-khush hoon tu bhi us se adaawat rakh Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) bhi us ke dushman ban jate hain phir aasmanon mein nida kar dete hain ki flan dushman-e-Ilahi tum sab us se bezar rehna chunacha aasman wale us se bigadte baithte hain phir wahi ghazab aur narazgi zameen par nazil hoti hai. (Bukhari Muslim waghera)

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ki jo banda apne Maula ki marzi ka talib ho jata hai aur us ki khushi ke kamon mein mashghool ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal Jibril (Alaihis Salam) se farmata hai ki mera flan banda mujhe khush karna chahta hai suno main us se khush ho gaya main ne apni rahmatein us par nazil karni shuru kar di hain. Pas Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) nida karte hain ki flan par rahmat-e-Ilahi ho gayi phir hamilan-e-Arsh bhi yehi munadi karte hain phir un ke pas wale gharz saton aasmanon mein yeh aawaz goonj jati hai phir zameen par us ki maqbuliyat utarti hai. Yeh hadith gharib hai aisi hi ek aur hadith bhi Musnad Ahmad mein gharabat wali hai jis mein yeh bhi hai ki mohabbat aur shohrat kisi ki burai ya bhalai ke sath aasmanon se Allah ki janib se utarti hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein isi qism ki hadith ke baad An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka is ayat-e-qurani ko padhna bhi marwi hai. Pas matlab ayat ka yeh hua ki naik amal karne wale imandaron se Allah khud mohabbat karta hai aur zameen par bhi un ki mohabbat aur maqbuliyat utari jati hai. Momin un se mohabbat karne lagte hain un ka zikr-e-khair hota hai aur un ki maut ke baad bhi un ki behtareen shohrat baqi rehti hai. 

Muzarram bin Habban kehte hain ki jo banda sache aur mukhlis dil se Allah ki taraf jhukta hai Allah Ta'ala mominon ke dilon ko us ki taraf jhuka deta hai woh us se mohabbat aur pyar karne lagte hain. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka farman hai banda jo bhalai burai karta hai Allah Ta'ala use isi ki chadar odha deta hai.
